title.zh: 卷六十四 志第十六: 河渠一
title.raw: 卷六十四 志第十六: 河渠一 Volume 64 Treatises 17: Rivers and Canals 1

sentences.zh: 河渠一

translations.literal: Rivers and Canals, Part One
translations.idiomatic: Rivers and Canals I

sentences.zh: 水為中國患，尚矣。

translations.literal: Water as China's affliction — this is long established.
translations.idiomatic: Water has been a scourge for China since antiquity.

sentences.zh: 知其所以為患，則知其所以為利，因其患之不可測而能先事而為之備，或後事而有其功，斯可謂善治水而能通其利者也。

translations.literal: To know why it is an affliction is to know why it is a benefit; because its harm cannot be foreseen, yet one can prepare beforehand, or act afterward yet still achieve merit — this may be called skill in managing water and making its benefits flow through.
translations.idiomatic: Understand why water harms, and you understand how it can help; since floods cannot be predicted, those who prepare in advance, or act after the fact yet still succeed, may truly be said to govern water well and turn its power to lasting gain.

sentences.zh: 昔者禹堙洪水，疏九河，陂九澤，以開萬世之利，而《周禮·地官》之屬，所載瀦防溝遂之法甚詳。

translations.literal: In antiquity Yu dammed the floodwaters, dredged the nine rivers, and embanked the nine marshes to open benefit for ten thousand generations; while the Earth Office section of the Zhou Rites and its related texts record in great detail methods of impounding, dikes, ditches, and canals.
translations.idiomatic: Long ago Yu controlled the Great Flood, cleared the Nine Rivers, and banked the Nine Marshes to secure benefits for ages to come; the Earth Office chapters of the Zhou Rituals preserve remarkably detailed regulations for reservoirs, embankments, trenches, and canals.

sentences.zh: 當是之時，天下蓋無適而非水利也。

translations.literal: At that time, there was probably nowhere in the realm that was not concerned with water works.
translations.idiomatic: In that era, virtually nowhere in the empire lay outside the scope of hydraulic management.

sentences.zh: 自先王疆理井田之制壞，而後水利之說興。

translations.literal: After the former kings' system of marking boundaries and the well-field system collapsed, only then did discourse on water conservancy arise.
translations.idiomatic: Once the ancient royal land-allotment and well-field systems had broken down, hydraulic projects came to be discussed as a separate field of policy.

sentences.zh: 魏史起鑿漳河，秦鄭國引涇水，漢鄭當時、王安世輩或獻議穿漕渠，或建策防水決，是數君子者，皆嘗試其術而卒有成功，太史公《河渠》一書猶可考。

translations.literal: Wei's Shi Qi excavated the Zhang River, Qin's Zheng Guo diverted the Jing River, and Han's Zheng Dangshi, Wang Anshi, and their kind either offered proposals to cut transport canals or devised plans to guard against breaches — these several gentlemen all tried their techniques and in the end had success; Grand Historian Sima Qian's "Rivers and Canals" book may still be consulted.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Qi of Wei opened the Zhang River, Zheng Guo of Qin brought in the Jing, and in Han times Zheng Dangshi, Wang Anshi, and others alike proposed canal cuts or flood-control measures. Each of these men put his plan to the test and ultimately succeeded; their achievements remain traceable in Sima Qian's Treatise on Rivers and Canals.

sentences.zh: 自時厥後，凡好事喜功之徒，率多為興利之言，而其患顧有不可勝言者矣。

translations.literal: From that time onward, all who delighted in meddling and vainglory mostly spoke words of creating profit, yet their afflictions indeed had what could not be told in full.
translations.idiomatic: After them, men eager for novelty and credit mostly talked of "creating benefits," while the disasters they caused could scarcely be reckoned.

sentences.zh: 夫潤下，水之性也，而欲為之防，以殺其怒，遏其沖，不亦甚難矣哉。

translations.literal: Now "moistening downward" is water's nature, yet wishing to make defenses for it, to kill its rage and restrain its rush — is this not very difficult?
translations.idiomatic: Water by nature flows downward and spreads; to pen it in, blunt its force, and check its rush is a task of extraordinary difficulty.

sentences.zh: 惟能因其勢而導之，可蓄則儲水以備旱暵之災，可泄則瀉水以防水潦之溢，則水之患息，而於是蓋有無窮之利焉。

translations.literal: Only by being able to follow its momentum and guide it — where storage is possible then store water against drought and famine disasters, where release is possible then drain water against flood deluge overflow — then water's affliction ceases, and thereby there is boundless benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Only by yielding to its current and channeling it—storing where one can to guard against drought, releasing where one must to shed flood—does the harm subside and immeasurable good follow.

sentences.zh: 元有天下，內立都水監，外設各處河渠司，以興舉水利、修理河堤為務。

translations.literal: When Yuan possessed the realm, within they established the Directorate of Waterways, without they set up river-canal offices in each region, taking promotion of water works and repair of river dikes as their charge.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Yuan ruled the empire, they established a central Directorate of Waterways and regional river-and-canal commissions, charged with promoting irrigation and maintaining embankments.

sentences.zh: 決雙塔、白浮諸水為通惠河，以濟漕運，而京師無轉餉之勞；

translations.literal: Opening the Shuangta and Baifu waters into the Tonghui Canal to aid grain transport, and the capital was without the toil of relaying provisions;
translations.idiomatic: They tapped the Shuangta and Baifu springs into the Tonghui Canal to feed the grain route, freeing the capital from overland grain haulage;

sentences.zh: 導渾河，疏灤水，而武清、平灤無墊溺之虞；

translations.literal: Guiding the Hun River, dredging the Luan River, and Wuqing and Pingluan were without fear of silting inundation;
translations.idiomatic: they redirected the Hun and cleared the Luan, so Wuqing and Pingluan no longer feared silting and inundation;

sentences.zh: 浚冶河，障滹沱，而真定免決嚙之患。

translations.literal: Dredging the Ye River, blocking the Hutuo, and Zhending was spared breach and gnawing afflictions.
translations.idiomatic: they dredged the Ye and dammed the Hutuo, sparing Zhending from breach and erosion.

sentences.zh: 開會通河於臨清，以通南北之貨；

translations.literal: Opening the Huitong Canal at Linqing to link north-south goods;
translations.idiomatic: They cut the Huitong Canal at Linqing to link north and south by water;

sentences.zh: 疏陜西之三白，以溉關中之田；

translations.literal: Dredging Shaanxi's Three Whites to irrigate Guanzhong fields;
translations.idiomatic: opened Shaanxi's Three White canals to water the fields of Guanzhong;

sentences.zh: 泄江湖之淫潦，立捍海之橫塘，而浙右之民得免於水患。

translations.literal: Draining the excessive flood of rivers and lakes, establishing sea-barrier cross-dikes, and the people of western Zhejiang were spared water afflictions.
translations.idiomatic: and drained surplus from rivers and lakes, built sea walls along the coast, so that the people of western Zhejiang were spared inundation.

sentences.zh: 當時之善言水利，如太史郭守敬等，蓋亦未嘗無其人焉。

translations.literal: At that time those skilled in speaking of water works, such as Grand Astrologer Guo Shoujing and others — probably there were never none such persons.
translations.idiomatic: Men of real hydraulic expertise, foremost among them Guo Shoujing, were never altogether lacking in that age.

sentences.zh: 一代之事功，所以為不可泯也。

translations.literal: A generation's achievement and merit, thereby became what cannot be extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Such were the works of that dynasty—achievements that cannot be effaced from memory.

sentences.zh: 今故著其開修之歲月，工役之次第，歷敘其事而分紀之，作《河渠志》。

translations.literal: Now therefore I record their opening and repair by year and month, labor and sequence of work, narrating the events in sequence and dividing them into records, composing the "Treatise on Rivers and Canals."
translations.idiomatic: I therefore set down the dates of each project and the order of its labor, recounting each undertaking in turn in this Treatise on Rivers and Canals.

sentences.zh: 通惠河

translations.literal: Tonghui Canal
translations.idiomatic: The Tonghui Canal

sentences.zh: 通惠河，其源出於白浮、甕山諸泉水也。

translations.literal: The Tonghui Canal — its source issues from Baifu, Wengshan, and the various spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: The Tonghui Canal takes its source from the springs of Baifu, Wengshan, and the surrounding hills.

sentences.zh: 世祖至元二十八年，都水監郭守敬奉詔興舉水利，因建言：「疏鑿通州至大都河，改引渾水溉田，於舊閘河蹤跡導清水，上自昌平縣白浮村引神山泉，西折南轉，過雙塔、榆河、一畝、玉泉諸水，至西水門入都城，南匯為積水潭，東南出文明門，東至通州高麗莊入白河，總長一百六十四里一百四步。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Zhiyuan of Emperor Shizu, Directorate of Waterways Guo Shoujing received an edict to promote water works and memorialized: "Dredge and excavate the river from Tongzhou to Dadu, change to draw the muddy river to irrigate fields, along the old sluice-river traces guide clear water — upstream from Baifu village in Changping county draw the Spirit Mountain spring, west turning south, passing Shuangta, Yuhe, Yimu, Yuquan waters, reaching the west water gate to enter the capital, south gathering as Jishuitan, southeast exiting Wenhua Gate, east to Tongzhou Gaolizhuang entering the Bai River, total length 164 li 104 steps.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year of the Zhiyuan era (1291), Guo Shoujing of the Directorate of Waterways, commissioned to advance hydraulic works, proposed: "Cut a canal from Tongzhou to Dadu; where the old sluice route allows, lead clear water while using the muddy stream for irrigation. From Baifu village in Changping, take the Spirit Mountain spring, bend west and south through the Shuangta, Yu, Yimu, and Yuquan streams, enter the capital at the West Water Gate, pool southward at Jishuitan, issue southeast through Wenhua Gate, and run east to Gaolizhuang in Tongzhou to join the Bai River—a total of 164 li and 104 paces.

sentences.zh: 塞清水口一十二處，共長三百一十步。

translations.literal: Blocked twelve clear-water openings, total length 310 steps.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve clear-water outlets were to be sealed, spanning 310 paces in all.

sentences.zh: 壩閘一十處，共二十座，節水以通漕運，誠為便益。」

translations.literal: Dam-slulices at ten places, twenty structures in all, regulating water to facilitate grain transport — truly convenient benefit."
translations.idiomatic: Ten dam-and-lock sites, twenty structures altogether, would regulate the flow for grain transport—a clear and lasting benefit."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the plan.

sentences.zh: 首事於至元二十九年之春，告成於三十年之秋，賜名曰通惠。

translations.literal: Work began in the spring of the twenty-ninth year of Zhiyuan, was reported complete in the autumn of the thirtieth year, and was granted the name Tonghui.
translations.idiomatic: Work began in the spring of 1292 and was declared finished in the autumn of 1293; the canal was given the name Tonghui, "Universal Benefit."

sentences.zh: 凡役軍一萬九千一百二十九，工匠五百四十二，水手三百一十九，沒官囚隸百七十二，計二百八十五萬工，用楮幣百五十二萬錠，糧三萬八千七百石，木石等物稱是。

translations.literal: In all there were employed soldiers 19,129, artisans 542, boatmen 319, confiscated-official convict bondservants 172, totaling 2,850,000 work-units, using 1,520,000 ingots of paper currency, grain 38,700 shi, timber and stone and other materials in proportion.
translations.idiomatic: The project mobilized 19,129 soldiers, 542 artisans, 319 boatmen, and 172 convict laborers, for 2,850,000 work-days; it consumed 1.52 million ingots of paper money, 38,700 shi of grain, and timber, stone, and other materials in proportion.

sentences.zh: 役興之日，命丞相以下皆親操畚鍤為之倡。

translations.literal: On the day labor was raised, the order was given that from the chancellor downward all should personally take basket and spade to lead the work.
translations.idiomatic: When construction began, the chancellor and all officials below him were ordered to take up basket and spade and lead the laborers by example.

sentences.zh: 置閘之處，往往於地中得舊時磚木，時人為之感服。

translations.literal: At places where locks were set, often in the ground they obtained old-time brick and timber; people of the time were moved to admiration.
translations.idiomatic: Where the new locks were built, workers often unearthed bricks and timbers from earlier works, to the wonder of all who saw them.

sentences.zh: 船既通行，公私兩便。

translations.literal: Once boats could pass, public and private both had convenience.
translations.idiomatic: Once shipping was open, both state and private interests benefited.

sentences.zh: 先時通州至大都五十里，陸挽官糧，歲若干萬，民不勝其悴，至是皆罷之。

translations.literal: Previously from Tongzhou to Dadu fifty li, overland hauling of official grain, yearly several tens of thousands — the people could not bear the exhaustion; by this time all was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Before this, official grain for the fifty li between Tongzhou and Dadu had been hauled overland by the tens of thousands of shi each year, a burden the people could scarcely endure; that practice was now abolished entirely.

sentences.zh: 其壩閘之名曰：廣源閘；

translations.literal: The names of its dam-slulices were: Guangyuan Lock;
translations.idiomatic: The dams and locks were named as follows: Guangyuan Lock;

sentences.zh: 西城閘二，上閘在和義門外西北一里，下閘在和義水門西三步；

translations.literal: Xicheng Locks two — upper lock one li northwest outside Heyi Gate, lower lock three steps west of Heyi Water Gate;
translations.idiomatic: two Xicheng locks—the upper one li northwest of Heyi Gate, the lower three paces west of the Heyi water gate;

sentences.zh: 海子閘，在都城內；

translations.literal: Haizi Lock, within the capital;
translations.idiomatic: the Haizi lock, inside the capital;

sentences.zh: 文明閘二，上閘在麗正門外水門東南，下閘在文明門西南一里；

translations.literal: Wenhua Locks two — upper lock southeast of the water gate outside Lizheng Gate, lower lock one li southwest of Wenhua Gate;
translations.idiomatic: two Wenhua locks—the upper southeast of the Lizheng water gate, the lower one li southwest of Wenhua Gate;

sentences.zh: 魏村閘二，上閘在文明門東南一里，下閘西至上閘一里；

translations.literal: Weicun Locks two — upper lock one li southeast of Wenhua Gate, lower lock one li west of the upper lock;
translations.idiomatic: two Weicun locks—the upper one li southeast of Wenhua Gate, the lower one li west of it;

sentences.zh: 籍東閘二，在都城東南王家莊；

translations.literal: Jidong Locks two, at Wangjiazhuang southeast of the capital;
translations.idiomatic: two Jidong locks at Wangjiazhuang, southeast of the capital;

sentences.zh: 郊亭閘二，在都城東南二十五里銀王莊；

translations.literal: Jiaoting Locks two, at Yinwangzhuang twenty-five li southeast of the capital;
translations.idiomatic: two Jiaoting locks at Yinwangzhuang, twenty-five li southeast of the capital;

sentences.zh: 通州閘二，上閘在通州西門外，下閘在通州南門外；

translations.literal: Tongzhou Locks two — upper lock outside Tongzhou west gate, lower lock outside Tongzhou south gate;
translations.idiomatic: two Tongzhou locks—the upper outside the west gate, the lower outside the south gate;

sentences.zh: 楊尹閘二，在都城東南三十里；

translations.literal: Yangyin Locks two, thirty li southeast of the capital;
translations.idiomatic: two Yangyin locks, thirty li southeast of the capital;

sentences.zh: 朝宗閘二，上閘在萬億庫南百步，下閘去上閘百步。

translations.literal: Chaozong Locks two — upper lock one hundred paces south of the Wanyi Storehouse, lower lock one hundred paces from the upper lock.
translations.idiomatic: and two Chaozong locks—the upper a hundred paces south of the Wanyi granary, the lower a hundred paces below it.

sentences.zh: 成宗元真元年四月，中書省臣言：「新開運河閘，宜用軍一千五百，以守護兼巡防往來船內奸宄之人。」

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Yuanzhen of Emperor Chengzong, Central Secretariat ministers said: "The newly opened transport canal locks should employ 1,500 soldiers to guard and also patrol against treacherous persons within passing boats."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of 1294, ministers of the Central Secretariat proposed: "The locks on the newly opened transport canal should be garrisoned by 1,500 troops to guard them and to patrol passing vessels for wrongdoers aboard."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 七月，工部言：「通惠河創造閘壩，所費不貲，雖已成功，全藉主守之人，上下照略修治。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the Works Ministry said: "The Tonghui Canal's creation of locks and dams cost immeasurably; though already successful, it wholly depends on those who hold and guard them, above and below inspecting and repairing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Ministry of Works reported: "The locks and dams on the Tonghui Canal cost a vast sum; though the project succeeded, its upkeep depends entirely on dedicated overseers who inspect and repair them regularly.

sentences.zh: 今擬設提領三員，管領人夫，專一巡護，降印給俸。

translations.literal: Now it is proposed to establish three superintendents to command laborers, devoted solely to patrol and guard, with seals issued and salaries granted.
translations.idiomatic: We propose appointing three superintendents to command the work crews, patrol the line exclusively, and receive official seals and salaries.

sentences.zh: 其西城閘改名會川，海子閘改名澄清，文明閘仍用舊名，魏村閘改名惠和，籍東閘改名慶豐，郊亭閘改名平津，通州閘改名通流，河門閘改名廣利，楊尹閘改名溥濟。」

translations.literal: The Xicheng Lock is renamed Huichuan, Haizi Lock renamed Chengqing, Wenhua Lock still uses the old name, Weicun Lock renamed Huihe, Jidong Lock renamed Qingfeng, Jiaoting Lock renamed Pingjin, Tongzhou Lock renamed Tongliu, Hemen Lock renamed Guangli, Yangyin Lock renamed Puji."
translations.idiomatic: The Xicheng lock is to be renamed Huichuan, the Haizi lock Chengqing, the Wenhua lock to keep its old name, the Weicun lock Huihe, the Jidong lock Qingfeng, the Jiaoting lock Pingjin, the Tongzhou lock Tongliu, the Hemen lock Guangli, and the Yangyin lock Puji."

sentences.zh: 武宗至大四年六月，省臣言：「通州至大都運糧河閘，始務速成，故皆用木，歲久木朽，一旦俱敗，然後致力，將見不勝其勞。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year of Zhidu of Emperor Wuzong, provincial ministers said: "The grain-transport canal locks from Tongzhou to Dadu, at first pursuing rapid completion, therefore all used wood; after years the wood rotted, and in one day all failed — only then was effort applied; one will see the labor cannot be borne.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1311, provincial ministers reported: "The locks on the grain canal from Tongzhou to Dadu were first built in haste, entirely of timber; after years the wood rotted and failed all at once, forcing repairs under emergency—labor that cannot be sustained.

sentences.zh: 今為永固計，宜用磚石，以次修治。」

translations.literal: Now for a plan of lasting solidity, brick and stone should be used, repairing in sequence."
translations.idiomatic: For a permanent solution, brick and stone should be used, with repairs carried out in orderly stages."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 後至泰定四年，始修完焉。

translations.literal: Later, by the fourth year of Taiding, repair was at last completed.
translations.idiomatic: Repairs were not finished until the fourth year of the Taiding era (1327).

sentences.zh: 文宗天歷三年三月，中書省臣言：「世祖時，開挑通惠河，安置閘座，全藉上源白浮、一畝等泉之水以通漕運。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year of Tianli of Emperor Wenzong, Central Secretariat ministers said: "In Emperor Shizu's time, the Tonghui Canal was opened and dredged, locks installed — wholly relying on upstream Baifu, Yimu, and other spring waters to facilitate grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of 1332, Central Secretariat ministers reported: "When the Tonghui Canal was cut under Emperor Shizu, its locks depended entirely on the headwaters from Baifu, Yimu, and the other springs to sustain grain transport.

sentences.zh: 今各枝及諸寺觀權勢，私決堤堰，澆灌稻田、水碾、園圃，致河淺妨漕事，乞禁之。」

translations.literal: Now various branches and powerful persons of temples and shrines privately breach dikes and dams, irrigating rice fields, water mills, and gardens, causing the river to grow shallow and obstruct grain transport — we beg that this be forbidden."
translations.idiomatic: Now branch streams and powerful monasteries illegally breach the dikes to irrigate paddies, run water mills, and water gardens, shallowing the canal and hindering transport—we ask that this be forbidden."

sentences.zh: 奉旨：白浮、甕山直抵大都運糧河堤堰泉水，諸人毋挾勢偷決，大司農司、都水監可嚴禁之。

translations.literal: Imperial decree: From Baifu and Wengshan straight to the Dadu grain-transport canal, dikes, dams, and spring waters — all persons must not rely on power to steal and breach; the Grand Secretariat for Agriculture and the Directorate of Waterways may strictly forbid it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed: "From Baifu and Wengshan to the Dadu grain canal, no one may use influence to breach dikes or divert springs; the Grand Secretariat for Agriculture and the Directorate of Waterways are to enforce the ban strictly."

sentences.zh: 壩河，亦名阜通七壩。

translations.literal: Dam River, also named the seven dams of Futong.
translations.idiomatic: The Dam River, also called the Seven Futong Dams

sentences.zh: 成宗大德六年三月，京畿漕運司言：「歲漕米百萬，全藉船壩夫力。

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixth year of Dade of Emperor Chengzong, the Capital Region Grain Transport Office said: "Yearly grain transport of one million — wholly relying on boat and dam laborers' strength.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of 1302, the Capital Region Grain Transport Office reported: "A million shi of tribute grain each year depends entirely on the boatmen and dam workers.

sentences.zh: 自冰開發運至河凍時止，計二百四十日，日運糧四千六百餘石，所轄船夫一千三百餘人，壩夫七百三十，占役俱盡，晝夜不息。

translations.literal: From ice break opening transport until river freeze, totaling 240 days, daily transport of grain 4,600-odd shi; boatmen under jurisdiction 1,300-odd persons, dam workers 730 — allotted service all exhausted, day and night without rest.
translations.idiomatic: From the ice break until the river froze—240 days—they moved more than 4,600 shi daily, with 1,300 boatmen and 730 dam workers under command, every man on duty and working day and night without pause.

sentences.zh: 今歲水漲，沖決壩堤六十餘處，雖已修畢，恐霖雨沖圮，走泄運水，以此點視河堤淺澀低薄去處，請加修理。」

translations.literal: This year waters rose, breaching dam-dikes at sixty-odd places; though already repaired, we fear heavy rain will wash and collapse them, draining off transport water — therefore we inspect places where river dikes are shallow, sluggish, low, and thin, and beg added repair."
translations.idiomatic: This year's flood breached more than sixty dam sections; though repairs are done, heavy rains may wash them out and drain the canal. We have surveyed weak, shallow, and low stretches of the embankment and request further work."

sentences.zh: 自五月四日入役，六月十二日畢，深溝壩九處，計一萬五千一百五十三工。

translations.literal: Labor began on the fourth day of the fifth month, finished on the twelfth day of the sixth month; Shen'gou Dam nine places, totaling 15,153 work-units.
translations.idiomatic: Work ran from the fourth day of the fifth month to the twelfth of the sixth: nine Shen'gou dams, 15,153 work-days in all.

sentences.zh: 王村壩二處，計七百十三工；

translations.literal: Wangcun Dam two places, totaling 713 work-units;
translations.idiomatic: Two Wangcun dams, 713 work-days;

sentences.zh: 鄭村壩一處，計一千一百二十五工；

translations.literal: Zhengcun Dam one place, totaling 1,125 work-units;
translations.idiomatic: one Zhengcun dam, 1,125 work-days;

sentences.zh: 西陽壩三處，計一千二百六十二工；

translations.literal: Xiyang Dam three places, totaling 1,262 work-units;
translations.idiomatic: three Xiyang dams, 1,262 work-days;

sentences.zh: 郭村壩三處，計一千九百八十七工。

translations.literal: Guocun Dam three places, totaling 1,987 work-units.
translations.idiomatic: and three Guocun dams, 1,987 work-days.

sentences.zh: 千斯壩下一處，計一萬工；

translations.literal: Qiansi Dam lower one place, totaling 10,000 work-units;
translations.idiomatic: One lower Qiansi dam, 10,000 work-days;

sentences.zh: 總用工三萬二百四十。

translations.literal: Total labor used: 30,240.
translations.idiomatic: for a grand total of 30,240 work-days.

sentences.zh: 金水河

translations.literal: Golden Water River
translations.idiomatic: The Golden Water River

sentences.zh: 金水河，其源出於宛平縣玉泉山，流至和義門南水門入京城，故得金水之名。

translations.literal: The Golden Water River — its source issues from Yuquan Mountain in Wanping county, flows to the south water gate of Heyi Gate to enter the capital, and therefore obtained the name Golden Water.
translations.idiomatic: The Golden Water River rises on Yuquan Mountain in Wanping county and enters the capital through the south water gate of Heyi Gate—hence its name.

sentences.zh: 至元二十九年二月，中書右丞馬速忽等言：「金水河所經運石大河及高良河、西河俱有跨河跳槽，今已損壞，請新之。」

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-ninth year of Zhiyuan, Right Vice-Chancellor of the Central Secretariat Masuhu and others said: "Where the Golden Water River passes the Yunshi Great River and Gaoliang River and Xi River, all have cross-river trestle flumes; now damaged — we beg they be renewed."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of 1292, Right Vice-Chancellor Masuhu and others reported: "The Golden Water River crosses the Yunshi Great River, the Gaoliang, and the Xi by trestle flumes, all now damaged—we ask that they be rebuilt."

sentences.zh: 是年六月興工，明年二月工畢。

translations.literal: That year the sixth month work was raised; the second month of the following year work was completed.
translations.idiomatic: Work began that June and was finished the following February.

sentences.zh: 至大四年七月，奉旨引金水河水註之光天殿西花園石山前舊池，置閘四以節水。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year of Zhidu, by imperial decree the Golden Water River was led to fill the old pool before the stone hill in the west garden of the Guangtian Hall, with four locks set to regulate water.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 1311, by imperial order the Golden Water was diverted into the old pool before the rockery in the west garden of the Guangtian Hall, with four sluice gates to regulate the flow.

sentences.zh: 閏七月興工，九月成，凡役夫匠二十九，為工二千七百二十三，除妨工，實役六十五日。

translations.literal: In the intercalary seventh month work was raised, completed in the ninth month; in all laborers and artisans twenty-nine, work-units 2,723, deducting obstructed work, actual labor sixty-five days.
translations.idiomatic: Construction began in the intercalary seventh month and was finished in the ninth; twenty-nine workers logged 2,723 work-days, or sixty-five days of actual labor after delays.

sentences.zh: 隆福宮前河

translations.literal: River before Longfu Palace
translations.idiomatic: The River before Longfu Palace

sentences.zh: 隆福宮前河，其水與太液池通。

translations.literal: The river before Longfu Palace — its water connects with the Taiye Pool.
translations.idiomatic: The river before Longfu Palace shares its water with the Taiye Pool.

sentences.zh: 英宗至治二年五月，奉敕云：「昔在世祖時，金水河濯手有禁，今則洗馬者有之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Zhizhi of Emperor Yingzong, by imperial command it was said: "Formerly in Emperor Shizu's time, washing hands in the Golden Water River was forbidden; now there are those who wash horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of 1322, an edict declared: "Under Emperor Shizu, washing one's hands in the Golden Water was forbidden; now men wash their horses there.

sentences.zh: 比至秋疏滌，禁諸人毋得汙穢。」

translations.literal: When autumn comes, dredge and cleanse; forbid all persons from defiling it."
translations.idiomatic: When autumn comes, dredge and cleanse it, and forbid anyone to defile the water."

sentences.zh: 於是會計修浚，三年四月興工，五月工畢，凡役軍八百，為工五千六百三十五。

translations.literal: Thereupon accounts were made for dredging; in the fourth month of the third year work was raised, fifth month completed; in all soldiers employed 800, work-units 5,635.
translations.idiomatic: Accounts were drawn up for dredging; work began in the fourth month of the third year and was finished in the fifth, with 800 soldiers and 5,635 work-days in all.

sentences.zh: 海子岸

translations.literal: Haizi Shore
translations.idiomatic: The Haizi Shore

sentences.zh: 海子岸，上接龍玉堂，以石甃其四周。

translations.literal: The Haizi Shore, above connecting with Longyu Hall, with stone lining its four sides.
translations.idiomatic: The Haizi shore, adjoining Longyu Hall above, was faced with stone on all sides.

sentences.zh: 海子一名積水潭，聚西北諸泉之水，流行入都城而匯於此，汪洋如海，都人因名焉。

translations.literal: Haizi, one name Jishuitan, gathers the waters of various springs of the northwest, flows into the capital and pools here, vast as the sea — the capital's people therefore named it thus.
translations.idiomatic: The Haizi, also called Jishuitan, collects the northwestern springs, flows into the capital, and pools here in a sheet wide as the sea—whence the people of the capital gave it its name.

sentences.zh: 仁宗延祐六年二月，都水監計會前後，興元修舊石岸相接，凡用石三百五，各長四尺，闊二尺五寸，厚一尺，石灰三千斤，該三百五工，丁夫五十，石工十，九月五日興工，十一日工畢。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year of Yanyou of Emperor Renzong, the Directorate of Waterways reckoned before and after, raised work to repair old stone shores connecting, in all using stone 305 pieces, each four chi long, two chi five cun wide, one chi thick, lime 3,000 jin, totaling 305 work-units, corvée laborers fifty, stonemasons ten; ninth month fifth day work raised, eleventh day completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of 1319 the Directorate of Waterways planned repairs to join the old stone revetments: 305 blocks, each four feet long, two and a half feet wide, and one foot thick, with 3,000 jin of lime—305 work-days, fifty corvée laborers, and ten masons; work began on the fifth day of the ninth month and was finished on the eleventh.

sentences.zh: 至治三年三月，大都河道提舉司言：「海子南岸東西道路，當兩城要沖，金水河浸潤於其上，海子風浪沖嚙於其下，且道狹，不時潰陷泥濘，車馬艱於往來，如以石砌之，實永久之計也。」

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year of Zhizhi, the Dadu River-Course Intendant Office said: "The east-west road on the Haizi south shore lies at the vital junction of the two cities; the Golden Water River seeps above it, Haizi wind and waves gnaw below it, and moreover the road is narrow, at times collapsing into mud — carts and horses have difficulty passing. If faced with stone, this is truly a plan for permanence."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of 1323 the Dadu River Intendant Office reported: "The east-west road along the south shore of the Haizi lies at a vital junction between the two cities; the Golden Water seeps above while wind and waves from the Haizi erode below. The road is narrow and often collapses into mud, making travel difficult—paving it with stone would be a lasting remedy."

sentences.zh: 泰定元年四月，工部應副工物，七月興工，八月工畢，凡用夫匠二百八十七人。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Taiding, the Works Ministry supplied materials; seventh month work raised, eighth month completed; in all laborers and artisans 287 persons used.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of 1324 the Ministry of Works supplied materials; work began in the seventh month and was finished in the eighth, employing 287 workers in all.

sentences.zh: 雙塔河

translations.literal: Shuangta River
translations.idiomatic: The Shuangta River

sentences.zh: 雙塔河，源出昌平縣孟村一畝泉，經雙塔店而東，至豐善村，入榆河。

translations.literal: The Shuangta River — its source issues from Yimu Spring at Mengcun in Changping county, passes east through Shuangta post-station, reaches Fengshan village, and enters the Yu River.
translations.idiomatic: The Shuangta River rises at the Yimu Spring in Mengcun, Changping county, runs east past Shuangta post-station to Fengshan village, and joins the Yu River.

sentences.zh: 至元三年四月六日，巡河官言：「雙塔河時將泛溢，不早為備，恐至潰決，臨期卒難措手。

translations.literal: On the sixth day of the fourth month of the third year of Zhiyuan, the river-patrol officer said: "The Shuangta River is about to overflow; if not prepared early, we fear it will breach — when the time comes it will be hard to act at once.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth day of the fourth month of 1266, the river patrol officer reported: "The Shuangta River is about to flood; unless we prepare now, it may breach—and at the last moment nothing can be done.

sentences.zh: 乃計會閉水口工物，開申都水監，創開雙塔河，未及堅久。

translations.literal: Thereupon he reckoned materials for closing water openings and reported to the Directorate of Waterways; the newly opened Shuangta River had not yet reached solidity and endurance.
translations.idiomatic: He tallied materials to seal the outlets and petitioned the Directorate of Waterways, noting that the newly cut Shuangta channel was not yet firmly established.

sentences.zh: 今已及水漲之時，倘或決壞，走泄水勢，誤運船不便。」

translations.literal: Now the time of rising water has arrived; if it should breach and fail, draining off the water momentum would hinder transport boats inconveniently."
translations.idiomatic: The flood season is upon us; if the works fail, the released current will disrupt grain transport."

sentences.zh: 省準制國用司給所需，都水監差夫修治焉。

translations.literal: The Secretariat approved; the State Revenue Office supplied what was needed; the Directorate of Waterways dispatched laborers to repair.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat approved; the State Revenue Office furnished supplies; and the Directorate of Waterways sent workers to make repairs.

sentences.zh: 凡合閉水口五處，用工二千一百五十五。

translations.literal: In all five water openings were to be closed, labor used 2,155.
translations.idiomatic: Five outlets were sealed in all, at a cost of 2,155 work-days.

sentences.zh: 盧溝河

translations.literal: Lugou River
translations.idiomatic: The Lugou River

sentences.zh: 盧溝河，其源出於代地，名曰小黃河，以流濁故也。

translations.literal: The Lugou River — its source issues from the Dai region, named Little Yellow River because its flow is turbid.
translations.idiomatic: The Lugou River rises in the Dai region and is called the Little Yellow River for its muddy current.

sentences.zh: 自奉聖州界流入宛平縣境，至都城四十里東麻谷，分為二派。

translations.literal: From the border of Fengsheng prefecture it flows into Wanping county territory; at forty li from the capital, Dongmagu, it divides into two branches.
translations.idiomatic: It enters Wanping county from Fengsheng prefecture and, forty li from the capital at Dongmagu, splits into two branches.

sentences.zh: 太宗七年歲乙未八月敕：「近劉沖祿言：『率水工二百餘人，已依期築閉盧溝河元破牙梳口，若不修堤固護，恐不時漲水沖壞，或貪利之人盜決溉灌，請令禁之。』

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the seventh year of Emperor Taizong, year yiwei, an edict: "Recently Liu Chonglu said: 'Leading more than 200 water workers, we have on schedule built and closed the Lugou River's formerly breached comb-tooth opening; if dikes are not repaired and secured, we fear untimely rising water will wash and destroy it, or persons greedy for profit will steal and breach to irrigate — we beg this be forbidden.'
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of 1235, an edict declared: "Liu Chonglu recently reported: 'With more than two hundred water workers I have closed the breached comb-gap on the Lugou River on schedule; unless the dikes are strengthened, sudden floods may destroy the work, or profiteers may breach it for irrigation—we ask that this be forbidden.'

sentences.zh: 劉沖祿可就主領，毋致沖塌盜決，犯者以違制論，徒二年，決杖七十。

translations.literal: Liu Chonglu may take charge of leading it; do not allow wash-collapse or theft-breach; violators are judged under violation of regulations — penal servitude two years, decision cane seventy strokes.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chonglu is to take charge and prevent breach or illegal diversion; offenders shall be punished under the statute on violations of imperial orders—two years' penal servitude and seventy strokes of the cane.

sentences.zh: 如遇修築時，所用丁夫器具，應差處調發之。

translations.literal: When repair and construction is encountered, corvée laborers and tools used shall be requisitioned from the appropriate offices.
translations.idiomatic: When repairs are needed, laborers and tools shall be requisitioned from the appropriate offices.

sentences.zh: 其舊有水手人夫內，五十人差官存留不妨。

translations.literal: Among the former boatmen and laborers within, fifty persons with an official dispatched to remain is not objectionable.
translations.idiomatic: Of the former boatmen and workers, fifty may remain under an appointed officer.

sentences.zh: 已委管領，常切巡視體究，歲一交番，所司有不應副者罪之。」

translations.literal: Already entrusted with management and leadership, constantly and urgently patrol and investigate, once yearly rotate shifts; offices that do not respond and supply shall be punished."
translations.idiomatic: He is entrusted with command, to patrol constantly and investigate thoroughly, with an annual rotation of duty; any office that fails to comply shall be punished."

sentences.zh: 白浮甕山

translations.literal: Baifu and Wengshan
translations.idiomatic: Baifu and Wengshan

sentences.zh: 白浮甕山，即通惠河上源之所出也。

translations.literal: Baifu and Wengshan — that is where the Tonghui Canal's upper source issues.
translations.idiomatic: Baifu and Wengshan are the source of the Tonghui Canal's headwaters.

sentences.zh: 白浮泉水在昌平縣界，西折而南，經甕山泊，自西水門入都城焉。

translations.literal: Baifu spring water lies on the border of Changping county, west turning south, passing Wengshan marsh, entering the capital from the west water gate.
translations.idiomatic: The Baifu spring lies in Changping county, bends west and south through Wengshan marsh, and enters the capital by the West Water Gate.

sentences.zh: 成宗大德七年六月，甕山等處看閘提領言：「自閏五月二十九日始，晝夜雨不止，六月九日夜半，山水暴漲，漫流堤上，沖決水口。」

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventh year of Dade under Emperor Chengzong, the lock overseer at Wengshan and other places reported: "Beginning from the twenty-ninth day of the intercalary fifth month, rain fell day and night without cease. At midnight on the ninth day of the sixth month, mountain water rose suddenly, flowed over the dikes, and breached the water outlet."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventh year of the Dade reign (1303), the lock overseer at Wengshan and nearby sites reported that unceasing rain had begun on the twenty-ninth day of the intercalary fifth month. At midnight on the ninth day of the sixth month, mountain torrents surged over the dikes and burst through the sluice.

sentences.zh: 於是都水監委官督軍夫，自九月二十一日入役，至是月終輟工，實役軍夫九百九十三人。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Directorate of Waterworks dispatched officials to supervise military laborers. Work began on the twenty-first day of the ninth month and halted at the end of that month. In all, 993 military laborers were actually employed.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Waterworks then sent officials to oversee military laborers. Work began on the twenty-first day of the ninth month and stopped at month's end, with 993 soldiers actually put to the task.

sentences.zh: 十一年三月，都水監言：「巡視白浮甕山河堤，崩三十餘里，宜編荊笆為水口，以泄水勢。」

translations.literal: In the third month of the eleventh year, the Directorate of Waterworks reported: "On inspection, the dikes along the Baifu and Wengshan rivers had collapsed for more than thirty li. Brushwood wattles should be woven at the water outlets to release the force of the water."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the eleventh year, the Directorate of Waterworks reported that inspections had found more than thirty li of collapsed dikes along the Baifu and Wengshan rivers. They recommended weaving brushwood wattles at the outlets to relieve the water pressure.

sentences.zh: 計修笆口十一處，四月興工，十月工畢。

translations.literal: Eleven wattle outlets were planned for repair. Work began in the fourth month and was completed in the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven wattle outlets were slated for repair. Construction began in the fourth month and finished in the tenth.

sentences.zh: 仁宗皇慶元年正月，都水監言：「白浮甕山堤，多低薄崩陷處，宜修治。」

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Huangqing under Emperor Renzong, the Directorate of Waterworks reported: "The Baifu and Wengshan dikes have many places that are low, thin, collapsed, or sunken. They should be repaired."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of the Huangqing reign (1312), the Directorate of Waterworks reported that the Baifu and Wengshan dikes had many sections that were low, thin, collapsed, or sunken, and ought to be repaired.

sentences.zh: 來春二月入役，八月修完，總修長三十七里二百十五步，計七萬三千七百七十三工。

translations.literal: Labor began the following spring in the second month; repairs were finished in the eighth month. The total length repaired was thirty-seven li and 215 paces, requiring 73,773 work-days.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring, labor began in the second month and was completed in the eighth. The work covered thirty-seven li and 215 paces in all, at a cost of 73,773 work-days.

sentences.zh: 延祐元年四月，都水監言：「自白浮甕山下至廣源閘堤堰，多淤澱淺塞，源泉微細，不能通流，擬疏滌。」

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Yanyou, the Directorate of Waterworks reported: "From below Baifu Wengshan to the dikes and weirs at Guangyuan Lock, there is much silt deposit and shallow blockage. The springs are slight and cannot flow freely. We propose dredging."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of the Yanyou reign (1314), the Directorate reported that from the foot of Baifu Wengshan down to the dikes and weirs at Guangyuan Lock, heavy silt had left the channel shallow and blocked, the spring flow too weak to pass freely. They proposed dredging.

sentences.zh: 由是會計工程，差軍千人疏治。

translations.literal: Accordingly the project was calculated and 1,000 soldiers were assigned to dredge and repair.
translations.idiomatic: The project was costed accordingly, and a thousand soldiers were assigned to dredge and clear the channel.

sentences.zh: 泰定四年八月，都水監言：「八月三日至六日，霖雨不止，山水泛溢，沖壞甕山諸處笆口，浸沒民田。」

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year of Taiding, the Directorate of Waterworks reported: "From the third to the sixth day of the eighth month, steady rain fell without cease. Mountain water overflowed, destroying the wattle outlets at Wengshan and other places and inundating private fields."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year of the Taiding reign (1327), the Directorate reported that from the third through the sixth day of the eighth month, unbroken rains had sent mountain floods crashing through the wattle outlets at Wengshan and elsewhere, inundating private farmland.

sentences.zh: 計料工物，移交工部關支修治。

translations.literal: Materials and labor were calculated and the matter was transferred to the Ministry of Works for allocation and repair.
translations.idiomatic: Materials and labor were estimated, and the case was referred to the Ministry of Works for funds and repairs.

sentences.zh: 自八月二十六日興工，九月十二日工畢，役軍夫二千名，實役九萬工，四十五日。

translations.literal: Work began on the twenty-sixth day of the eighth month and was completed on the twelfth day of the ninth month. Two thousand military laborers were mobilized; 90,000 work-days were actually expended over forty-five days.
translations.idiomatic: Work began on the twenty-sixth day of the eighth month and ended on the twelfth day of the ninth. Two thousand military laborers were deployed, consuming 90,000 work-days over forty-five days.

sentences.zh: 渾河，本盧溝水，從大興縣流至東安州、武清縣，入漷州界。

translations.literal: The Hun River is originally the waters of the Lugou. It flows from Daxing County through Dong'an Prefecture and Wuqing County into the territory of Huozhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Hun River is essentially the Lugou River. It runs from Daxing County through Dong'an Prefecture and Wuqing County into Huozhou.

sentences.zh: 至大二年十月，渾河水決左都威衛營西大堤，泛溢南流，沒左右二翊及後衛屯田麥，由是左都威衛言：「十月五日，水決武清縣王甫村堤，闊五十餘步，深五尺許，水西南漫平地流，環圓營倉局，水不沒者無幾。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the second year of Zhida, the Hun River breached the great dike west of the Left Capital Guard camp. It overflowed southward and submerged the wheat fields of the Left and Right Assistants and the Rear Guard garrison farms. Thereupon the Left Capital Guard reported: "On the fifth day of the tenth month, the river breached the dike at Wangfu Village in Wuqing County, a gap more than fifty paces wide and about five chi deep. The water spread southwest across level ground, encircling the round camp granary offices; scarcely anything remained above water.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the second year of the Zhida reign (1309), the Hun River broke through the great dike west of the Left Capital Guard camp and flooded south, drowning the wheat on the garrison farms of the Left and Right Assistants and the Rear Guard. The Left Capital Guard then reported that on the fifth day of the tenth month the river had torn open the dike at Wangfu Village in Wuqing County—a breach more than fifty paces wide and some five chi deep. Water spread southwest across the flat land and wrapped around the circular camp granary; almost nothing stayed dry.

sentences.zh: 恐來春冰消，夏雨水作，沖決成渠，軍民被害，或遷置營司，或多差軍民修塞，庶免墊溺。」

translations.literal: We fear that when the ice melts next spring and summer rains come, the breach may be cut into a channel, harming soldiers and civilians. Either the camp offices should be relocated, or more soldiers and civilians should be assigned to repair and block it, so that inundation may be avoided."
translations.idiomatic: They feared that when the ice melted the following spring and summer rains arrived, the breach would widen into a permanent channel and harm both troops and civilians. They asked either to relocate the camp offices or to assign more soldiers and civilians to plug the break and avert disaster.

sentences.zh: 三年二月十二日，省準下左右翊及後衛、大都路委官督工修治，至五月二十日工畢。

translations.literal: On the twelfth day of the second month of the third year, the provincial office approved and ordered the Left and Right Assistants, the Rear Guard, and the Dadu Circuit to dispatch officials to supervise repairs, which were completed on the twentieth day of the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth day of the second month of the third year, the provincial office approved the plan and ordered the Left and Right Assistants, the Rear Guard, and Dadu Circuit to send officials to oversee the work, which was finished on the twentieth day of the fifth month.

sentences.zh: 延祐元年六月十七日，左衛言：「六月十四日，渾河決武清縣劉家莊堤口，差軍七百與東安州民夫協力同修之。」

translations.literal: On the seventeenth day of the sixth month of the first year of Yanyou, the Left Guard reported: "On the fourteenth day of the sixth month, the Hun River breached the dike at Liujiazhuang in Wuqing County. Seven hundred soldiers were assigned, together with laborers from Dong'an Prefecture, to repair it jointly."
translations.idiomatic: On the seventeenth day of the sixth month of the first year of Yanyou, the Left Guard reported that on the fourteenth the Hun River had broken through the dike at Liujiazhuang in Wuqing County. Seven hundred soldiers were dispatched, along with laborers from Dong'an Prefecture, to repair it together.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，省議：「渾河決堤堰，沒田禾，軍民蒙害，既已奏聞。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year, the provincial office deliberated: "The Hun River has breached dikes and weirs and submerged crops; soldiers and civilians have suffered harm. This has already been reported to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year, the provincial office deliberated: "The Hun River has burst dikes and weirs, drowning crops and harming soldiers and civilians. The matter has already been reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 差官相視，上自石徑山金口，下至武清縣界舊堤，長計三百四十八里，中間因舊修築者大小四十七處，漲水所害合修補者一十九處，無堤創修者八處，宜疏通者二處，計工三十八萬一百，役軍夫三萬五千，九十六日可畢。

translations.literal: Officials were dispatched to inspect. From Shijing Mountain at Jinkou upstream to the old dikes at the Wuqing County boundary, the total length was 348 li. Among these, forty-seven large and small sections were repaired on the old foundations; nineteen places damaged by floodwaters needed patching; eight places without dikes required new construction; and two places needed clearing. The project was estimated at 380,100 work-days, requiring 35,000 military laborers and ninety-six days to complete.
translations.idiomatic: Inspectors were sent out. From Shijing Mountain at Jinkou upstream to the old dikes on the Wuqing County border, the line measured 348 li in all. Of this, forty-seven large and small sections could be rebuilt on old foundations; nineteen flood-damaged spots needed patching; eight stretches lacked dikes and required new construction; and two needed dredging. The estimate was 380,100 work-days, 35,000 military laborers, and ninety-six days to finish.

sentences.zh: 如通築則役大難成，就令分作三年為之，省院差官先發軍民夫匠萬人，興工以修其要處。」

translations.literal: If built in one continuous effort the labor would be too great and hard to finish. It should be divided over three years. The provincial office and the Censorate should dispatch officials and first mobilize ten thousand soldiers, civilians, laborers, and craftsmen to begin work on the critical sections."
translations.idiomatic: A single continuous build would demand too much labor to succeed. The work should be spread over three years. The provincial office and Censorate should send officials and first mobilize ten thousand soldiers, civilians, laborers, and craftsmen to tackle the most critical sections."

sentences.zh: 是月二十日，樞府奏撥軍三千，委中衛僉事督修治之。

translations.literal: On the twentieth day of that month, the Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized allocating three thousand soldiers, with a vice commissioner of the Central Guard supervising the repairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the twentieth day of that month, the Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized allocating three thousand soldiers under a vice commissioner of the Central Guard to supervise the repairs.

sentences.zh: 七年五月，營田提舉司言：「去歲十二月二十一日，屯戶巡視廣賦屯北渾河堤二百餘步將崩，恐春首土解水漲，浸沒為患，乞修治。」

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the seventh year, the Garrison Farm Intendant reported: "On the twenty-first day of the twelfth month of last year, garrison households on patrol found that a stretch of more than 200 paces of the Hun River dike north of Guangfu Garrison was about to collapse. We fear that when the soil thaws at the start of spring and the water rises, it will inundate and cause harm. We request repairs."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventh year, the Garrison Farm Intendant reported that on the twenty-first day of the twelfth month of the previous year, garrison households on patrol had found more than 200 paces of the Hun River dike north of Guangfu Garrison on the verge of collapse. They feared that when the ground thawed in early spring and the river rose, flooding would follow, and asked for repairs.

sentences.zh: 都水監委濠寨，會營田提舉司官、武清縣官，督夫修完廣武屯北陷薄堤一處，計二千五百工；

translations.literal: The Directorate of Waterworks delegated the moat garrison, together with officials of the Garrison Farm Intendant and Wuqing County, to supervise labor in completing one thin, sunken section of dike north of Guangwu Garrison, estimated at 2,500 work-days;
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Waterworks assigned the moat garrison, together with officials from the Garrison Farm Intendant and Wuqing County, to supervise repairs on one thin, sunken stretch of dike north of Guangwu Garrison—2,500 work-days;

sentences.zh: 永興屯北堤低薄一處，計四千一百六十六工；

translations.literal: one low, thin section of dike north of Yongxing Garrison, estimated at 4,166 work-days;
translations.idiomatic: one low, thin section north of Yongxing Garrison—4,166 work-days;

sentences.zh: 落褵村西沖圮一處，計三千七百三十三工；

translations.literal: one section washed away west of Luoli Village, estimated at 3,733 work-days;
translations.idiomatic: one washed-out section west of Luoli Village—3,733 work-days;

sentences.zh: 永興屯北崩圮一處，計六千五百十八工；

translations.literal: one collapsed section north of Yongxing Garrison, estimated at 6,518 work-days;
translations.idiomatic: one collapsed section north of Yongxing Garrison—6,518 work-days;

sentences.zh: 北王村莊西河東岸至白墳兒，南至韓村西道口，計六千九十三工；

translations.literal: from the east bank of the river west of Beiwang Village to Baifener, south to the west crossing at Hancun Village, estimated at 6,093 work-days;
translations.idiomatic: from the east bank west of Beiwang Village to Baifener, south to the west crossing at Hancun Village—6,093 work-days;

sentences.zh: 劉邢莊西河東岸北至寶僧百戶屯，南至白墳兒，計三萬七百十二工。

translations.literal: from the east bank west of Liuxingzhuang north to the Baoseng Centurion garrison, south to Baifener, estimated at 30,712 work-days.
translations.idiomatic: from the east bank west of Liuxingzhuang north to the Baoseng Centurion garrison, south to Baifener—30,712 work-days.

sentences.zh: 總用工五萬三千七百二十二。

translations.literal: The total labor required was 53,722 work-days.
translations.idiomatic: In all, the work required 53,722 work-days.

sentences.zh: 泰定四年四月，省議：「三年六月內霖雨，山水暴漲，泛沒大興縣諸鄉桑棗田園，移文樞府，於七衛屯田及見有軍內，差三千人修治。」

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year of Taiding, the provincial office deliberated: "In the sixth month of the third year, steady rains caused mountain water to rise suddenly and flood the mulberry, jujube, fields, and gardens of various townships in Daxing County. A dispatch was sent to the Bureau of Military Affairs to assign three thousand men from the seven guard garrison farms and available troops to repair the damage."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year of Taiding, the provincial office noted that in the sixth month of the third year, prolonged rains had sent mountain floods over the mulberry groves, jujube orchards, fields, and gardens of Daxing County. They had already written the Bureau of Military Affairs to assign three thousand men from the seven guard garrison farms and available troops to make repairs.

sentences.zh: 白河

translations.literal: The Bai River
translations.idiomatic: The Bai River

sentences.zh: 白河，在漷州東四里，北出通州潞縣，南入於通州境，又東南至香河縣界，又流入於武清縣境，達於靜海縣界。

translations.literal: The Bai River lies four li east of Huozhou. It emerges north from Lu County in Tongzhou, enters Tongzhou territory to the south, then turns southeast to the border of Xianghe County, and flows east into Wuqing County and on to the border of Jinghai County.
translations.idiomatic: The Bai River lies four li east of Huozhou. It rises north from Lu County in Tongzhou, runs south into Tongzhou, turns southeast to the Xianghe County border, then flows east through Wuqing County to the Jinghai County line.

sentences.zh: 至元三十年九月，漕司言：「通州運糧河全仰白、榆、渾三河之水，合流名曰潞河，舟楫之行有年矣。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the thirtieth year of Zhiyuan, the Grain Transport Office reported: "The grain transport river at Tongzhou relies entirely on the waters of the Bai, Yu, and Hun rivers, which join and are called the Lu River. Ships have traveled it for many years.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the thirtieth year of the Zhiyuan reign (1293), the Grain Transport Office reported that Tongzhou's grain canal depended wholly on the Bai, Yu, and Hun rivers, which merged to form the Lu River—a route ships had used for years.

sentences.zh: 今歲新開閘河，分引渾、榆二河上源之水，故自李二寺至通州三十餘里，河道淺澀。

translations.literal: This year the newly opened lock river diverted the upper reaches of the Hun and Yu rivers, so from Li'er Temple to Tongzhou, a stretch of more than thirty li, the channel became shallow and sluggish.
translations.idiomatic: That year the newly opened lock canal had diverted the upper reaches of the Hun and Yu rivers, leaving the thirty-odd li from Li'er Temple to Tongzhou shallow and sluggish.

sentences.zh: 今春夏天旱，有止深二尺處，糧船不通，改用小料船搬載，淹延歲月，致虧糧數。

translations.literal: This spring and summer there was drought; in places the depth was only two chi. Grain boats could not pass and had to be unloaded onto smaller craft, delaying months and causing loss of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Spring and summer brought drought; in places the depth fell to only two chi. Grain barges could not pass and had to transfer cargo to smaller boats, delaying transport for months and costing grain.

sentences.zh: 先是，都水監相視白河，自東岸吳家莊前，就大河西南，斜開小河二里許，引榆河合流至深溝壩下，以通漕舟。

translations.literal: Previously, the Directorate of Waterworks had inspected the Bai River and, starting from the east bank in front of Wujiazhuang, cut a small river diagonally southwest for about two li along the main stream to draw the Yu River below Shenggou Dam, so that transport vessels might pass.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Directorate of Waterworks had surveyed the Bai River and, from the east bank below Wujiazhuang, cut a diagonal channel southwest for about two li along the main stream to bring Yu River water below Shenggou Dam and keep transport boats moving.

sentences.zh: 今丈量，自深溝、榆河上灣，至吳家莊龍王廟前白河，西南至壩河八百步。

translations.literal: Measurements now show that from the upper bend of Shenggou and the Yu River to the Bai River in front of Longwang Temple at Wujiazhuang, and southwest to the dam river, the distance is 800 paces.
translations.idiomatic: New measurements showed that from the upper bend at Shenggou and the Yu River to the Bai River in front of Longwang Temple at Wujiazhuang, and southwest to the dam channel, the distance was 800 paces.

sentences.zh: 及巡視，知榆河上源築閉，其水盡趨通惠河，止有白佛、靈溝、一子母三小河水入榆河，泉脈微，不能勝舟。

translations.literal: On inspection it was found that the upper reaches of the Yu River had been dammed and closed off; its water all ran toward the Tonghui River. Only the three small streams of Baifo, Linggou, and Yizimu entered the Yu River, and their springs were slight—too weak to support shipping.
translations.idiomatic: Inspection showed that the upper Yu had been dammed shut, its water entirely diverted to the Tonghui River. Only the three minor streams—Baifo, Linggou, and Yizimu—still fed the Yu, and their flow was too slight to carry boats.

sentences.zh: 擬自吳家莊就龍王廟前閉白河，於西南開小渠，引水自壩河上灣入榆河，庶可漕運。

translations.literal: It is proposed to close the Bai River at Wujiazhuang in front of Longwang Temple, open a small canal to the southwest, and draw water from the upper bend of the dam river into the Yu River, so that grain transport may be possible.
translations.idiomatic: They proposed closing the Bai River at Longwang Temple below Wujiazhuang, opening a small canal to the southwest, and drawing water from the upper bend of the dam channel into the Yu so grain transport could resume.

sentences.zh: 又深溝樂歲五倉，積貯新舊糧七十餘萬石，站車挽運艱緩，由是訪視通州城北通惠河積水，至深溝村西水渠，去樂歲、廣儲等倉甚近，擬自積水處由舊渠北開四百步，至樂歲倉西北，以小料船運載甚便。」

translations.literal: Also, at Leyear's five granaries at Shenggou, more than 700,000 shi of old and new grain were stored. Cart transport by relay stations was slow and difficult. Therefore they surveyed the pooled water of the Tonghui River north of Tongzhou city, reaching the water channel west of Shengou Village, very near the Leyear, Guangchu, and other granaries. It was proposed to open 400 paces north from the pooled water along the old channel to the northwest of Leyear Granary, so that transport by small craft would be very convenient."
translations.idiomatic: At Shenggou, Leyear's five granaries held more than 700,000 shi of old and new grain, and relay-cart haulage was slow and arduous. Surveyors therefore examined the pooled water of the Tonghui north of Tongzhou city, which reached a channel west of Shengou Village—very close to the Leyear and Guangchu granaries. They proposed reopening 400 paces north from the pool along the old channel to the northwest corner of Leyear Granary, where small boats could load and unload with ease.

sentences.zh: 都省準焉。

translations.literal: The Metropolitan Secretariat approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Metropolitan Secretariat approved the plan.

sentences.zh: 通惠河自通州城北，至樂歲西北，水陸共長五百步，計役八萬六百五十工。

translations.literal: From north of Tongzhou city on the Tonghui River to the northwest of Leyear, the combined water and land route was 500 paces long, requiring 80,650 work-days.
translations.idiomatic: From north of Tongzhou on the Tonghui River to the northwest of Leyear Granary, the combined water-and-land route measured 500 paces and required 80,650 work-days.

sentences.zh: 大德二年五月，中書省劄付都水監：運糧河堤自楊村至河西務三十五處，用葦一萬九千一百四十束，軍夫二千六百四十九名，度三十日畢。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Dade, the Secretariat of the Central Government issued a directive to the Directorate of Waterworks: along the grain transport river dikes from Yangcun to Hexiwu there were thirty-five places requiring 19,140 bundles of reeds, 2,649 military laborers, and thirty days to complete.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Dade, the Central Secretariat directed the Directorate of Waterworks to repair thirty-five sections of grain-canal dike from Yangcun to Hexiwu, budgeting 19,140 bundles of reeds, 2,649 military laborers, and thirty days.

sentences.zh: 於是本監分官率濠寨至楊村歷視壞堤，督巡河夫修理，以霖雨水溢，故工役倍元料，自寺洵口北至蔡村、清口、孫家務、辛莊、河西務堤，就用元料葦草，修補卑薄，創築月堤，頗有成功。

translations.literal: Thereupon this directorate divided officials who led the moat garrison to Yangcun to inspect damaged dikes in sequence and supervise river patrol laborers in repairs. Because steady rain caused water to overflow, the labor exceeded the original estimate. From Siyunkou north to the dikes at Caicun, Qingkou, Sunjiawu, Xinzhuang, and Hexiwu, they used the originally allotted reeds and grass to patch low, thin sections and build new crescent dikes, with considerable success.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate then split its staff, sending moat-garrison officers to Yangcun to inspect damaged dikes in turn and supervise river patrol laborers. Heavy rains swelled the water and doubled the work beyond the original estimate. From Siyunkou north through the dikes at Caicun, Qingkou, Sunjiawu, Xinzhuang, and Hexiwu, they used the allotted reeds and grass to patch weak sections and build new crescent dikes with considerable success.

sentences.zh: 其楊村兩岸相對出水河口四處，葦草不敷，就令軍夫采刈，至九月住役。

translations.literal: At four outlet points on opposite banks at Yangcun, reeds and grass were insufficient, so military laborers were ordered to cut and gather more. Work halted in the ninth month.
translations.idiomatic: At four outlet points on opposite banks at Yangcun, reeds ran short, so soldiers were sent to cut and gather more. Work stopped in the ninth month.

sentences.zh: 楊村河上接通惠諸河，下通滹沱入江淮，使官民舟楫直達都邑，利國便民。

translations.literal: The Yangcun River connects upward with the Tonghui and other rivers and downward with the Hutuo, reaching the Yangtze and Huai. It allows official and private vessels to reach the capital directly, benefiting the state and the people.
translations.idiomatic: The Yangcun River links upstream to the Tonghui and other waterways and downstream to the Hutuo and on toward the Yangtze and Huai, letting official and private craft reach the capital directly to the benefit of state and people alike.

sentences.zh: 奈楊村堤岸隨修隨圮，蓋為用力不固，徒煩工役，其未修者，候來春水涸土幹，調軍夫修治。

translations.literal: Yet the Yangcun dikes collapsed as fast as they were repaired, because the work was not solidly done, wasting labor in vain. For sections not yet repaired, military laborers should be mobilized when the water recedes next spring and the soil dries.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Yangcun's dikes failed as fast as they were rebuilt—the work had not been done solidly, and labor was wasted. Unfinished sections should wait until the following spring, when the water fell and the soil dried, before soldiers were sent back to finish.

sentences.zh: 延祐六年十月，省臣言：「漕運糧儲及南來諸物商賈舟楫，皆由直沽達通惠河。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the sixth year of Yanyou, provincial officials reported: "Grain transport, stored provisions, and merchant vessels carrying goods from the south all reach the Tonghui River by way of Zhigu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the sixth year of Yanyou, provincial officials reported that grain transport, stored provisions, and southern merchant traffic all reached the Tonghui River via Zhigu.

sentences.zh: 今岸崩泥淺，不早疏浚，有礙舟行，必致物價翔湧。

translations.literal: Now the banks are collapsing and the mud is shallow. If dredging is not done soon, navigation will be obstructed and prices will surely soar.
translations.idiomatic: The banks were crumbling and the channel silting shallow. Without prompt dredging, boats would be blocked and prices would surely spike.

sentences.zh: 都水監職專水利，宜分官一員，以時巡視，遇有頹圮淺澀，隨宜修築，如功力不敷，有司差夫助役，怠事者究治。」

translations.literal: The Directorate of Waterworks is charged solely with water control. One official should be assigned to inspect on schedule. Wherever banks collapse or channels shoal, repairs should be made as needed. If labor is insufficient, the responsible office should assign laborers to assist. Negligence should be investigated and punished."
translations.idiomatic: Since the Directorate of Waterworks held sole responsibility for water control, they proposed assigning one official to inspect on schedule, repairing collapses and shoals as found. Where labor fell short, local offices should supply helpers, and negligence should be punished.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 至治元年正月十一日，漕司言：「夏運海糧一百八十九萬餘石，轉漕往返，全藉河道通便，今小直沽汊河口潮汐往來，淤泥壅積七十餘處，漕運不能通行，宜移文都水監疏滌。」

translations.literal: On the eleventh day of the first month of the first year of Zhizhi, the Grain Transport Office reported: "The summer transport of 1,890,000-odd shi of sea grain, with round-trip transfer, depends entirely on an unobstructed river channel. Now at the Xiaozhigu branch mouth, where tides ebb and flow, silt has accumulated at more than seventy places and grain transport cannot pass. A dispatch should be sent to the Directorate of Waterworks to dredge."
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh day of the first month of the first year of Zhizhi (1321), the Grain Transport Office reported that the summer shipment of more than 1,890,000 shi of sea grain depended on a clear channel for the round trip. At the Xiaozhigu branch mouth, where tides flowed back and forth, silt had choked more than seventy spots and grain boats could not pass. They asked the Directorate of Waterworks to dredge.

sentences.zh: 工部議：「時農作方興，兼民多艱食，若不差軍助役，民力有所不逮。」

translations.literal: The Ministry of Works deliberated: "Farm work is now underway, and many people lack food. If soldiers are not assigned to assist, civilian strength will be insufficient."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Works replied that spring planting was underway and many people were going hungry. Without soldiers to help, civilian labor would not suffice.

sentences.zh: 樞密院言：「軍人不敷。」

translations.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs reported: "Soldiers are insufficient."
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Military Affairs answered that troops were unavailable.

sentences.zh: 省議：「若差民丁，方今東作之時，恐妨歲事。

translations.literal: The provincial office deliberated: "If civilian laborers are assigned, it is now the season for eastern fieldwork, and we fear harm to the year's harvest.
translations.idiomatic: The provincial office noted that drafting civilians now, at the height of eastern fieldwork, would threaten the harvest.

sentences.zh: 其令大都募民夫三千，日給傭鈔一兩、糙粳米一升，委正官提調，驗日支給，令都水監暨漕司官同督其事。」

translations.literal: Let Dadu recruit three thousand civilian laborers, giving each one tael of hired-labor cash and one sheng of coarse husked rice per day. A responsible official should be appointed to manage distribution, verified and paid daily. Officials of the Directorate of Waterworks and the Grain Transport Office should jointly supervise the work."
translations.idiomatic: They ordered Dadu to recruit three thousand day laborers, paying each one tael of hired-labor cash and one sheng of coarse rice daily under a responsible official who verified and disbursed wages each day, with the Directorate of Waterworks and Grain Transport Office jointly supervising.

sentences.zh: 四月十一日入役，五月十日工畢。

translations.literal: Work began on the eleventh day of the fourth month and was completed on the tenth day of the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: Work began on the eleventh day of the fourth month and finished on the tenth day of the fifth.

sentences.zh: 致和元年六月六日，臨清御河萬戶府言：「泰定四年八月二日，河溢，壞營北門堤約五十步，漂舊樁木百餘，崩圮猶未已。」

translations.literal: On the sixth day of the sixth month of the first year of Zhihe, the Linqing Imperial River Ten-thousand Households Office reported: "On the second day of the eighth month of the fourth year of Taiding, the river overflowed and destroyed about fifty paces of the dike at the camp's north gate. More than a hundred old piles were washed away, and collapse had not yet ceased."
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth day of the sixth month of the first year of Zhihe (1328), the Linqing Imperial River Ten-thousand Households Office reported that on the second day of the eighth month of the fourth year of Taiding the river had overflowed, destroying about fifty paces of the north-gate dike, washing away more than a hundred old piles, with the bank still giving way.

sentences.zh: 工部議：「河岸崩摧，理宜修治，既都水監會計工物，各處支給，其役夫三千人，若擬差民，方春恐妨農務，宜移文樞密院撥軍。」

translations.literal: The Ministry of Works deliberated: "When river banks collapse, repair is proper. Since the Directorate of Waterworks has already calculated materials and labor and supplies are being issued from various places, three thousand laborers are needed. If civilians are drafted, spring fieldwork may be harmed. A dispatch should be sent to the Bureau of Military Affairs to allocate soldiers."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Works held that collapsed banks ought to be repaired. The Directorate had already costed materials and labor, with supplies drawn from various offices; three thousand workers were needed. Drafting civilians in spring would harm farming, so they asked the Bureau of Military Affairs for troops.

sentences.zh: 省準修舊堤岸，展闊新河口東岸，計工五萬九千九百三十七，用軍三千、木匠十人。

translations.literal: The provincial office approved repairing the old dikes and widening the east bank of the new river mouth. The project was estimated at 59,937 work-days, using three thousand soldiers and ten carpenters.
translations.idiomatic: The provincial office approved repairs to the old dikes and widening of the east bank at the new river mouth—59,937 work-days, three thousand soldiers, and ten carpenters.

sentences.zh: 天歷二年三月，漕司言：「元開劉二總管營相對河，比舊河運糧迂遠，乞委官相視，復開舊河便。」

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year of Tianli, the Grain Transport Office reported: "The river opened by Administrator Liu the Second opposite his camp is more circuitous for grain transport than the old river. Officials should be assigned to inspect and reopen the old river, which would be more convenient."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of Tianli (1329), the Grain Transport Office reported that the channel opened by Administrator Liu the Second opposite his camp made grain transport more circuitous than the old river. They asked for inspectors to survey and reopen the old route.

sentences.zh: 四月九日，奏準，差軍七千，委兵部員外郎鄧衡、都水監丞阿裏、漕使太不花等督工修浚。

translations.literal: On the ninth day of the fourth month, the memorial was approved. Seven thousand soldiers were assigned, with Vice Minister of War Deng Heng, Vice Director of Waterworks Ali, and Grain Transport Commissioner Taibuhua supervising dredging and repair.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth day of the fourth month the memorial was approved. Seven thousand soldiers were assigned under Vice Minister of War Deng Heng, Vice Director Ali of the Directorate of Waterworks, and Grain Transport Commissioner Taibuhua to dredge and reopen the channel.

sentences.zh: 後以冬寒，候凍解興役。

translations.literal: Because of winter cold, work was deferred until the ice thawed.
translations.idiomatic: Winter cold intervened, and work waited until the ice broke up.

sentences.zh: 三年，工部移文大都，於近甸募民夫三千，日支糙粳米三升、中統鈔一兩，兵部改委辛侍郎暨元委官修辟。

translations.literal: In the third year, the Ministry of Works sent a dispatch to Dadu to recruit three thousand civilian laborers from the nearby districts, paying three sheng of coarse husked rice and one tael of Zhongtong cash per day. The Ministry of War replaced the assignment with Vice Minister Xin and the originally appointed officials to dredge and open the channel.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the Ministry of Works ordered Dadu to recruit three thousand laborers from the nearby countryside, paying three sheng of coarse rice and one tael of Zhongtong cash daily. The Ministry of War reassigned Vice Minister Xin, together with the original commissioners, to dredge and reopen the channel.

sentences.zh: 至順元年六月，都水監言：「二十三日夜，白河水驟漲丈餘，觀音寺新修護倉堤，已督有司差夫救護，今水落尺餘，宜候伏槽興作。」

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Zhishun, the Directorate of Waterworks reported: "On the night of the twenty-third, the Bai River rose suddenly by more than one zhang. The newly repaired protective granary dike at Guanyin Temple had already been placed under local officials with laborers assigned for emergency rescue. The water has now fallen by more than one chi. Work should wait until the low-water season of summer."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Zhishun (1330), the Directorate reported that on the night of the twenty-third the Bai River had surged more than one zhang. Officials had already rushed laborers to the newly repaired protective dike at Guanyin Temple. The water had since dropped more than one chi; construction should wait until the summer low-water season.

sentences.zh: 御河

translations.literal: The Imperial River
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial River

sentences.zh: 御河，自大名路魏縣界經元城縣泉源鄉於村度，南北約十里，東北流至包家渡，下接館陶縣界三口。

translations.literal: The Imperial River, from the border of Wei County in Daming Circuit, passes through Yuancheng County at Quanyuan Township in Yucun for about ten li north and south, flows northeast to Baojia Ford, and descends to three mouths at the border of Guantao County.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial River enters from Wei County on the Daming Circuit border, runs about ten li north and south through Quanyuan Township at Yucun in Yuancheng County, flows northeast to Baojia Ford, and descends to three mouths on the Guantao County line.

sentences.zh: 御河上從交河縣，下入清池縣界。

translations.literal: Upstream on the Imperial River it comes from Jiaohe County and flows down into Qingchi County.
translations.idiomatic: Upstream it comes from Jiaohe County and runs down into Qingchi County.

sentences.zh: 又永濟河在清池縣西三十里，自南皮縣來，入清州，今呼為御河也。

translations.literal: Also, the Yongji River lies thirty li west of Qingchi County. It comes from Nanpi County, enters Qing Prefecture, and is now called the Imperial River.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongji River, thirty li west of Qingchi County, rises in Nanpi County, enters Qing Prefecture, and is now also called the Imperial River.

sentences.zh: 至元三年七月六日，都水監言：「運河二千餘里，漕公私物貨，為利甚大。

translations.literal: On the sixth day of the seventh month of the third year of Zhiyuan, the Directorate of Waterworks reported: "The transport canal of more than 2,000 li carries public and private goods by grain transport; its benefit is very great.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth day of the seventh month of the third year of Zhiyuan (1266), the Directorate reported that the transport canal—more than 2,000 li long—moved public and private cargo by grain transport to enormous benefit.

sentences.zh: 自兵興以來，失於修治，清州之南，景州以北，頹闕岸口三十餘處，淤塞河流十五里。

translations.literal: Since the outbreak of war it has lacked repair. South of Qing Prefecture and north of Jing Prefecture, more than thirty bank mouths have collapsed and fifteen li of river channel are silted and blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Since the wars began it had gone unrepaired. South of Qing Prefecture and north of Jing Prefecture, more than thirty breaches had opened in the banks and fifteen li of channel were silted shut.

sentences.zh: 至癸巳年，朝廷役夫四千，修築浚滌，乃復行舟。

translations.literal: In the guisi year the court mobilized four thousand laborers to build dikes and dredge, and shipping resumed.
translations.idiomatic: In the guisi year the court sent four thousand laborers to build dikes and dredge, and boats could pass again.

sentences.zh: 今又三十餘年，無官主領。

translations.literal: Now another thirty-odd years have passed with no official in charge.
translations.idiomatic: Another thirty-odd years had since passed with no one officially in charge.

sentences.zh: 滄州地分，水面高於平地，全藉堤堰防護。

translations.literal: In the Cangzhou region the water surface is higher than the level ground; protection depends entirely on dikes and weirs.
translations.idiomatic: In the Cangzhou region the river stood higher than the surrounding land and depended entirely on dikes and weirs for protection.

sentences.zh: 其園圃之家掘堤作井，深至丈餘，或二丈，引水以溉蔬花。

translations.literal: Garden owners dig through the dikes to make wells, sometimes more than one zhang deep or even two zhang, drawing water to irrigate vegetables and flowers.
translations.idiomatic: Garden owners dug through the dikes to sink wells—sometimes more than one zhang deep, even two—to draw water for vegetables and flowers.

sentences.zh: 復有瀕河人民就堤取土，漸至闕破，走泄水勢，不惟澀行舟，妨運糧，或致漂民居，沒禾稼。

translations.literal: Also, people living along the river took earth from the dikes, gradually breaking them open and releasing the water's force. This not only made navigation sluggish and obstructed grain transport, but could also wash away dwellings and submerge crops.
translations.idiomatic: Riverfront residents also stripped earth from the dikes, slowly opening breaches that released the current. Boats ran aground and grain transport stalled; homes were swept away and crops drowned.

sentences.zh: 其長蘆以北，索家馬頭之南，水內暗藏樁橛，破舟船，壞糧物。」

translations.literal: North of Changlu and south of Suojia Matou, piles and stakes were hidden beneath the water, breaking boats and ruining grain cargo."
translations.idiomatic: North of Changlu and south of Suojia Matou, hidden piles and stakes beneath the water wrecked boats and ruined grain cargo.

sentences.zh: 部議以濱河州縣佐貳之官兼河防事，於各地分巡視，如有闕破，即率眾修治，拔去樁橛，仍禁園圃之家毋穿堤作井，栽樹取土。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated that assistant officials of riverine prefectures and counties should concurrently handle river defense. They should patrol their districts; wherever breaches appeared, they should lead the people in repair, pull out piles and stakes, and still forbid garden owners from piercing dikes for wells, planting trees, or taking earth.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry proposed that deputy officials in riverine prefectures and counties also oversee river defense—patrolling their districts, leading repairs at any breach, pulling hidden stakes, and forbidding garden owners to pierce dikes for wells, plant trees, or strip earth.

sentences.zh: 都省準議。

translations.literal: The Metropolitan Secretariat approved the deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The Metropolitan Secretariat approved.

sentences.zh: 七年，省臣言：「御河水泛武清縣，計疏浚役夫一十，工八十日可畢。」

translations.literal: In the seventh year, provincial officials reported: "The Imperial River has overflowed into Wuqing County. Dredging is estimated to require ten laborers and eighty days to complete."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year provincial officials reported that the Imperial River had flooded Wuqing County. Dredging would take ten laborers and eighty days.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 延祐三年七月，滄州言：「清池縣民告，往年景州吳橋縣諸處御河水溢，沖決堤岸，萬戶千奴為恐傷其屯田，差軍築塞舊泄水郎兒口，故水無所泄，浸民廬及已熟田數萬頃，乞遣官疏辟，引水入海。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year of Yanyou, Cangzhou reported: "Commoners of Qingchi County petitioned that in former years when the Imperial River overflowed at various places in Jing Prefecture's Wuqiao County, the breach destroyed dikes. The ten-thousand-household commander Qiannu, fearing harm to his garrison fields, assigned soldiers to block the old outlet called Lang'er Mouth, so the water had nowhere to drain.
