It inundated private dwellings and tens of thousands of qing of ripe fields. They request officials be sent to dredge and open a channel to lead the water to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year of Yanyou, Cangzhou reported that Qingchi commoners had petitioned: when the Imperial River had overflowed at Wuqiao County in Jing Prefecture in earlier years, Ten-thousand-household Commander Qiannu, fearing for his garrison fields, had sent soldiers to seal the old outlet called Lang'er Mouth. With no escape for the water, it had flooded homes and tens of thousands of qing of ripe fields. They asked for officials to dredge a channel and send the water to the sea.

sentences.zh: 及七月四日，決吳橋縣柳斜口東岸三十餘步，千戶移僧又遣軍閉塞郎兒口，水壅不得泄，必致漂蕩張管、許河、孟村三十餘村黍谷廬舍，故本州摘官相視，移文約會開闢，不從。」

translations.literal: Also, on the fourth day of the seventh month, the east bank at Liuxiekou in Wuqiao County was breached for more than thirty paces. Centurion Yiseng again sent soldiers to block Lang'er Mouth. The water, dammed and unable to drain, would surely wash away the millet, grain, dwellings, and houses of more than thirty villages including Zhangguan, Xuhe, and Mengcun. This prefecture therefore sent officials to inspect and wrote coordinating dispatches to open the channel, but they were not obeyed."
translations.idiomatic: Then, on the fourth day of the seventh month, the east bank at Liuxiekou in Wuqiao County broke for more than thirty paces. Centurion Yiseng again blocked Lang'er Mouth with troops. Water backed up with no outlet, threatening more than thirty villages—Zhangguan, Xuhe, Mengcun, and others—with flooded millet, grain, and homes. Cangzhou sent inspectors and coordinating dispatches to reopen the channel, but the orders were ignored.

sentences.zh: 四年五月，都水監遣官與河間路官相視元塞郎兒口，東西長二十五步，南北闊二十尺，及堤南高一丈四尺，北高二丈餘，復按視郎兒口下流故河，至滄州約三十餘里，上下古跡寬闊，及減水故道，名曰盤河。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year, the Directorate of Waterworks sent officials with Hejian Circuit officials to inspect the formerly blocked Lang'er Mouth—twenty-five paces long east to west, twenty chi wide north to south, with the south bank one zhang four chi high and the north bank more than two zhang high. They also surveyed the old channel below Lang'er Mouth to Cangzhou, about thirty-odd li. Ancient traces above and below were broad, including the old flood-relief channel called Pan River.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year, the Directorate sent officials with Hejian Circuit officers to survey the sealed Lang'er Mouth—twenty-five paces east to west, twenty chi north to south, the south bank one zhang four chi high, the north more than two zhang. They also traced the old channel below Lang'er Mouth to Cangzhou, some thirty-odd li, where ancient traces ran wide, including the old flood-relief route called Pan River.

sentences.zh: 今為開闢郎兒口，增浚故河，決積水，由滄州城北達滹沱河，以入於海。

translations.literal: Now, to open Lang'er Mouth and deepen the old channel, break through the pooled water, and reach the Hutuo River north of Cangzhou city to enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was to reopen Lang'er Mouth, deepen the old channel, cut through the pooled water, and run north of Cangzhou city to the Hutuo River and the sea.

sentences.zh: 泰定元年九月，都水監遣官督丁夫五千八百九十八人，是月二十八日興工，十月二日工畢。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Taiding, the Directorate of Waterworks sent officials to supervise 5,898 laborers. Work began on the twenty-eighth day of that month and was completed on the second day of the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the first year of Taiding (1324), the Directorate supervised 5,898 laborers. Work began on the twenty-eighth day of that month and finished on the second day of the tenth.

sentences.zh: 灤河

translations.literal: The Luan River
translations.idiomatic: The Luan River

sentences.zh: 灤河，源出金蓮川中，由松亭北，經遷安東、平州西，瀕灤州入海也。

translations.literal: The Luan River rises in Jinlianchuan, passes north of Songting, runs east of Qian'an and west of Ping Prefecture, and reaches the sea along Luan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Luan River rises in Jinlianchuan, passes north of Songting, runs east of Qian'an and west of Ping Prefecture, and reaches the sea at Luan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 王曾《北行錄》云：「自偏槍嶺四十里，過烏灤河，東有灤州，因河為名。」

translations.literal: Wang Zeng's Record of a Journey North says: "Forty li from Pianqiang Ridge one crosses the Wuluan River; to the east is Luan Prefecture, named for the river."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zeng's Record of a Journey North notes: "Forty li from Pianqiang Ridge one crosses the Wuluan River; Luan Prefecture lies to the east, named for the river."

sentences.zh: 至元二十八年八月，省臣奏：「姚演言，奉敕疏浚灤河，漕運上都，乞應副沿河蓋露囷工匠什物，仍預備來歲所用漕船五百艘，水手一萬，牽船夫二萬四千。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twenty-eighth year of Zhiyuan, provincial officials memorialized: "Yao Yan reports that by imperial order he is dredging the Luan River for grain transport to the Upper Capital. He requests support along the river for exposed granary craftsmen and equipment, and advance preparation for next year's need of five hundred transport boats, ten thousand boatmen, and twenty-four thousand tow-path laborers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-eighth year of Zhiyuan (1291), provincial officials memorialized that Yao Yan, ordered to dredge the Luan for grain transport to the Upper Capital, asked for craftsmen, tools, and exposed granary support along the river, plus advance preparation of five hundred transport boats, ten thousand boatmen, and twenty-four thousand tow-path laborers for the coming year.

sentences.zh: 臣等集議，近歲東南荒歉，民力雕弊，造舟調夫，其事非輕，一時並行，必致重困。

translations.literal: We have deliberated together. In recent years the southeast has suffered famine and the people's strength is exhausted. Building boats and mobilizing laborers is no light matter; doing both at once would surely cause severe hardship.
translations.idiomatic: They deliberated together: the southeast had suffered famine in recent years and the people were exhausted. Building boats and drafting laborers was no small burden; doing both at once would crush the region.

sentences.zh: 請先造舟十艘，量撥水手試行之，如果便，續增益。」

translations.literal: We request that ten boats be built first and boatmen assigned proportionally for a trial run. If it proves convenient, additions may follow."
translations.idiomatic: They asked to build ten boats first, assign boatmen proportionally, and trial the route—expanding only if it proved workable.

sentences.zh: 制可其奏，先以五十艘行之，仍選能人同事。

translations.literal: The emperor approved the memorial, but first ordered fifty boats put into service, still selecting capable men to manage the work jointly.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved the memorial but ordered fifty boats into service first, with capable men chosen to manage the effort jointly.

sentences.zh: 大德五年八月十三日，平灤路言：「六月九日霖雨，至十五日夜，灤河與淝、洳三河並溢，沖圮城東西二處舊護城堤、東西南三面城墻，橫流入城，漂郭外三關瀕河及在城官民屋廬糧物，沒田苗，溺人畜，死者甚眾，而雨猶不止。

translations.literal: On the thirteenth day of the eighth month of the fifth year of Dade, the Pingluan Circuit reported: "From the ninth day of the sixth month steady rain fell until the night of the fifteenth, when the Luan River together with the Fei and Ru rivers all overflowed. They destroyed the old protective dikes east and west of the city and the city walls on the east, south, and west sides. Water poured crosswise into the city, washing away the three outer passes along the river and official and private buildings and grain inside the city, submerging crops, drowning livestock, and killing many people—and the rain still did not stop.
translations.idiomatic: On the thirteenth day of the eighth month of the fifth year of Dade (1301), Pingluan Circuit reported that from the ninth day of the sixth month rain had fallen without pause until the night of the fifteenth, when the Luan, Fei, and Ru rivers all burst their banks. Old protective dikes east and west of the city collapsed, as did walls on the east, south, and west. Water swept into the city, carrying off the three outer river gates, buildings and grain inside and outside the walls, crops, and livestock. Many drowned—and still the rain would not stop.

sentences.zh: 至二十四日夜，灤、漆、淝、洳諸河水復漲入城，余屋漂蕩殆盡。」

translations.literal: By the night of the twenty-fourth, the Luan, Qi, Fei, and Ru rivers rose again and entered the city; the remaining buildings were nearly all washed away."
translations.idiomatic: By the night of the twenty-fourth the Luan, Qi, Fei, and Ru rivers surged again into the city, and nearly every building left standing was swept away.

sentences.zh: 乃委吏部馬員外同都水監官修之，東西二堤，計用工三十一萬一千五十，鈔八千八十七錠十五兩，糙粳米三千一百一十石五斗，樁木等價鈔二百七十四錠二十六兩四錢。

translations.literal: Thereupon Vice Director Ma of the Ministry of Personnel was assigned, together with officials of the Directorate of Waterworks, to repair the east and west dikes. The project required 311,050 work-days, 8,087 ingots and fifteen liang of cash, 3,110 shi and five dou of coarse husked rice, and piles and timber valued at 274 ingots, twenty-six liang, and four qian of cash.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director Ma of the Ministry of Personnel was then assigned, with Directorate officials, to rebuild the east and west dikes—311,050 work-days, 8,087 ingots and fifteen liang of cash, 3,110 shi and five dou of coarse rice, and piles and timber worth 274 ingots, twenty-six liang, and four qian.

sentences.zh: 延祐四年六月十六日，上都留守司言：「正月一日，城南御河西北岸為水沖嚙，漸至頹圮，若不修治，恐來春水泛漲，漂沒民居。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth day of the sixth month of the fourth year of Yanyou, the Upper Capital Retention Office reported: "On the first day of the first month, the northwest bank of the Imperial River south of the city was eroded by water, gradually collapsing. If not repaired, we fear that when spring waters rise next year, private dwellings will be washed away.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth day of the sixth month of the fourth year of Yanyou (1317), the Upper Capital Retention Office reported that on the first day of the first month the northwest bank of the Imperial River south of the city had been gnawed away by the current and was slowly collapsing. Without repairs, spring floods the next year would wash away private homes.

sentences.zh: 又開平縣言，四月二十六日霖雨，至二十八日夜，東關灤河水漲，沖損北岸，宜擬修築。

translations.literal: Also, Kaiping County reported that from the twenty-sixth day of the fourth month steady rain fell until the night of the twenty-eighth, when the Luan River at the east gate rose and damaged the north bank. Repair was proposed.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiping County also reported that from the twenty-sixth day of the fourth month rain had fallen until the night of the twenty-eighth, when the Luan at the east gate rose and damaged the north bank. They proposed repairs.

sentences.zh: 本司議，即目仲夏霖雨，其水復溢，必大為害，乃委官督夫匠興役。

translations.literal: This office deliberated that it was now midsummer with steady rain; the water would overflow again and surely cause great harm. Officials were therefore assigned to supervise laborers and craftsmen in starting work.
translations.idiomatic: The Retention Office judged that midsummer rains would send the river over its banks again with serious damage. Officials were dispatched at once to supervise laborers and craftsmen.

sentences.zh: 開平發民夫，幼小不任役，請調軍供作，庶可速成。」

translations.literal: Kaiping mobilized civilian laborers, but the young and weak could not bear the work. They requested soldiers be assigned instead so the work might be completed quickly."
translations.idiomatic: Kaiping had mobilized civilians, but the young and weak could not manage the labor. They asked for soldiers instead so the work could finish quickly.

sentences.zh: 五月二十一日，留守司言：「灤河水漲決堤，計修築用軍六百，宜令樞密院差調，官給其食。」

translations.literal: On the twenty-first day of the fifth month, the Retention Office reported: "The Luan River has risen and breached the dikes. Repairs will require six hundred soldiers. The Bureau of Military Affairs should be ordered to assign them, with rations supplied by the state."
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-first day of the fifth month, the Retention Office reported that the Luan had risen and broken the dikes. Repairs would need six hundred soldiers; the Bureau of Military Affairs should assign them with state rations.

sentences.zh: 制曰：「今維其時，移文樞密院發軍速為之。」

translations.literal: A decree stated: "The time is now — send a dispatch to the Bureau of Military Affairs to mobilize troops and carry this out at once."
translations.idiomatic: The court decreed that the moment had come: the Bureau of Military Affairs should be instructed at once to mobilize troops.

sentences.zh: 虎賁司發軍三百治焉。

translations.literal: The Tiger Guard Command sent three hundred soldiers to carry out the repairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Tiger Guard Command dispatched three hundred soldiers to do the work.

sentences.zh: 泰定二年三月十三日，永平路屯田總管府言：「國家經費咸出於民，民之所生，無過農作。

translations.literal: On the thirteenth day of the third month of the second year of Taiding, the Yongping Circuit Garrison Farm Directorate reported: "All state revenue comes from the people, and among what the people produce nothing surpasses farming.
translations.idiomatic: On the thirteenth day of the third month of the second year of Taiding (1325), the Yongping Circuit Garrison Farm Directorate reported that all state revenue came from the people and that nothing they produced mattered more than farming.

sentences.zh: 本屯辟田收糧，以供億內府之用，不為不重。

translations.literal: This garrison opens fields and collects grain to supply the needs of the inner capital granaries — the burden is no small one.
translations.idiomatic: This garrison cleared land and collected grain for the inner capital granaries — a weighty responsibility.

sentences.zh: 訪馬城東北五里許張家莊龍灣頭，在昔有司差夫築堤，以防灤水，西南連清水河，至公安橋，皆本屯地分。

translations.literal: At Longwan Head in Zhangjia Village, about five li northeast of Fangma City, officials in the past had assigned laborers to build dikes against the Luan River; running southwest to connect with the Qingshui River as far as Gongan Bridge — all within this garrison's jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: At Longwan Head in Zhangjia Village, some five li northeast of Fangma City, officials had once assigned laborers to build dikes against the Luan. The line ran southwest to the Qingshui River and Gongan Bridge, all within the garrison's lands.

sentences.zh: 去歲霖雨，水溢，沖蕩皆盡，浸死屯民田苗，終歲無收。

translations.literal: Last year's heavy rains caused the water to overflow and wash everything away, drowning the garrison farmers' seedlings so that there was no harvest all year.
translations.idiomatic: Last year's rains had sent the river over the dikes and scoured everything away, drowning the garrison farmers' crops and leaving them with no harvest for the year.

sentences.zh: 方今農隙，若不預修，必致為害。」

translations.literal: Now, in the farming interval, if repairs are not made in advance, harm is sure to follow."
translations.idiomatic: With the farming season at a lull, failure to repair the dikes in advance would surely bring disaster.

sentences.zh: 工部移文都水監，差濠寨泊本屯官及灤州官新詣相視，督令有司差夫補築。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Works sent a dispatch to the Directorate of Waterworks to assign waterworks garrison officers and local garrison officials together with Luan Prefecture officials to inspect the site and supervise the local offices in assigning laborers to rebuild the dikes.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Works wrote the Directorate of Waterworks, which sent garrison waterworks officers and Luan Prefecture officials to inspect the site and have local offices assign laborers to rebuild the dikes.

sentences.zh: 三年五月十日，上都留守司及本路總管府言：「巡視大西關南馬市口灤河遞北堤，侵嚙漸崩，不預治，恐夏霖雨水泛，貽害居民。」

translations.literal: On the tenth day of the fifth month of the third year, the Upper Capital Retention Office and this circuit's chief directorate reported: "On inspection, the dike north of the Luan River at Mashikou, south of the Great West Gate, is being eaten away and slowly collapsing. If not repaired beforehand, we fear summer rains will flood and harm the residents."
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth day of the fifth month of the third year, the Upper Capital Retention Office and the circuit chief directorate reported that the dike north of the Luan at Mashikou, south of the Great West Gate, was being undercut and slowly collapsing. Without advance repairs, summer floods would threaten the residents.

sentences.zh: 於是送都城所丈量，計用物修治，工部移文上都分部施行。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Capital Construction Office was sent to measure the work and calculate materials for repair; the Ministry of Works dispatched instructions to the Upper Capital branch for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The Capital Construction Office was sent to survey and estimate materials; the Ministry of Works then ordered the Upper Capital branch to proceed.

sentences.zh: 七月二日，右丞相塔失帖木兒等奏：「斡耳朵思住冬營盤，為灤河走淩河水沖壞，將築護水堤，宜令樞密院發軍千二百人以供役。」

translations.literal: On the second day of the seventh month, the Right Chancellor Taishi Temür and others memorialized: "The ordo's winter encampment has been damaged by ice-run on the Luan River. Protective dikes are to be built, and it is appropriate to order the Bureau of Military Affairs to send twelve hundred soldiers for the labor."
translations.idiomatic: On the second day of the seventh month, Right Chancellor Taishi Temür and others reported that the ordo's winter camp had been wrecked by ice floes on the Luan and that protective dikes should be built. They asked the Bureau of Military Affairs to supply twelve hundred soldiers.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 樞密院請遣軍千二百人。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs requested dispatch of twelve hundred soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Military Affairs applied to send twelve hundred soldiers.

sentences.zh: 河間河

translations.literal: Hejian River
translations.idiomatic: The Hejian River

sentences.zh: 河間河，在河間路界。

translations.literal: The Hejian River lies within the boundaries of Hejian Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Hejian River lay within Hejian Circuit.

sentences.zh: 泰定三年三月，都水監言：「河間路水患，古儉河，自北門外始，依舊疏通，至大成縣界，以泄上源水勢，引入鹽河，古陳玉帶河，自軍司口浚治，至雄州歸信縣界，以導澱濼積潦，註之易河。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year of Taiding, the Directorate of Waterworks reported: "Hejian Circuit suffers from flooding. The ancient Jian River, starting outside the north gate, should be dredged as before to the border of Dacheng County to release upstream water and channel it into the Salt River. The ancient Chen Yudai River should be cleared from Junsikou to the border of Guixin County in Xiong Prefecture to drain accumulated marsh water into the Yi River.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year of Taiding, the Directorate of Waterworks reported on Hejian Circuit's flood problem. The ancient Jian River, beginning outside the north gate, should be dredged as before to Dacheng County to bleed off upstream flow into the Salt River. The ancient Chen Yudai River should be cleared from Junsikou to Guixin County in Xiong Prefecture to drain marsh water into the Yi River.

sentences.zh: 黃龍港，自鎖井口開鑿，至文安縣玳瑁口，以通濼水，經火燒澱，轉流入海。

translations.literal: Huanglong Harbor should be opened from Suojingkou to Daiyaokou in Wen'an County to connect with marsh water, passing through Huoshao Marsh and turning to flow into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Huanglong Harbor should be cut from Suojingkou to Daiyaokou in Wen'an County to link the marsh waters, pass through Huoshao Marsh, and discharge into the sea.

sentences.zh: 計河宜疏者三十處，總役夫三萬，三十日可畢。」

translations.literal: In all, thirty places along the rivers should be dredged, requiring thirty thousand laborers and completable in thirty days."
translations.idiomatic: Thirty stretches of river needed dredging in all — thirty thousand laborers could finish in thirty days.

sentences.zh: 是月省臣奏準，遣斷事官定住同元委都水孫監丞洎本處有司官，於旁近州縣發丁夫三萬，日給鈔一兩、米一升，先詣古陳玉帶河。

translations.literal: That month the provincial officials memorialized for approval and dispatched investigating officials together with the previously assigned Directorate Vice Director Sun and local officials to mobilize thirty thousand corvée laborers from nearby prefectures and counties, with a daily allowance of one liang of cash and one sheng of rice, beginning first at the ancient Chen Yudai River.
translations.idiomatic: That month the province approved the plan and sent investigating officials with the assigned Directorate Vice Director Sun and local officers to raise thirty thousand corvée laborers from nearby counties, each paid one liang of cash and one sheng of rice per day, starting on the ancient Chen Yudai River.

sentences.zh: 尋以歲旱民饑，役興人勞罷，候年登為之。

translations.literal: Soon, because drought had brought famine, the labor was suspended to spare the people; work would wait until the harvest was good.
translations.idiomatic: Drought and famine soon forced a halt to spare the people; the project would wait for a good harvest year.

sentences.zh: 冶河，在真定路平山縣西門外，經井陘縣流來本縣東北十里，入滹沱河。

translations.literal: The Ye River is outside the west gate of Pingshan County in Zhending Circuit; flowing from Jingxing County, it passes ten li northeast of this county and enters the Hutuo River.
translations.idiomatic: The Ye River ran outside the west gate of Pingshan County in Zhending Circuit. It came from Jingxing County, passed ten li northeast of the county seat, and joined the Hutuo River.

sentences.zh: 元貞元年正月十八日，丞相完澤等言：「往年先帝嘗命開真定冶河，已發丁夫人役，適值先帝升遐，以聚眾罷之。

translations.literal: On the eighteenth day of the first month of the first year of Yuanzhen, Chancellor Wanze and others reported: "In former years the late emperor ordered the Ye River in Zhending opened; corvée laborers had already been mobilized when the late emperor passed away, and the project was halted because of the assembled crowd.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighteenth day of the first month of the first year of Yuanzhen (1295), Chancellor Wanze and others reported that the late emperor had once ordered the Ye River in Zhending opened. Corvée labor had been mobilized, but when the emperor died the work was halted.

sentences.zh: 今請遵舊制，俾卒其事。」

translations.literal: We now ask to follow the former regulations and finish the task."
translations.idiomatic: They asked to follow the old plan and complete the work.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 皇慶元年七月二日，真定路言：「龍花、判官莊諸處壞堤，計工物，申請省委都水監及本路官，自平山縣西北，歷視滹沱、冶河合流，急註真定西南關，由是再議，照冶河故道，自平山縣西北河內，改修滾水石堤，下修龍塘堤，東南至水碾村，改引河道一里，蒲吾橋西，改辟河道一里。

translations.literal: On the second day of the seventh month of the first year of Huangqing, Zhending Circuit reported: "Broken dikes at Longhua, Panguan Village, and other places — after calculating labor and materials, provincial officials, the Directorate of Waterworks, and circuit officers were requested to inspect from northwest Pingshan County along the confluence of the Hutuo and Ye rivers and the urgent outlet at Zhending's southwest gate. On further deliberation, following the Ye River's old course from northwest Pingshan County, an overflow stone dike was to be rebuilt in the river; the Longtang dike was to be repaired downstream; one li of channel was to be opened southeast to Shuinian Village; and one li of channel was to be cut west of Puwu Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On the second day of the seventh month of the first year of Huangqing (1312), Zhending Circuit reported broken dikes at Longhua, Panguan Village, and elsewhere. After estimating labor and materials, it asked provincial officials and the Directorate to inspect from northwest Pingshan along the Hutuo–Ye confluence and the urgent outlet at Zhending's southwest gate. The plan called for rebuilding an overflow stone dike on the Ye's old course, repairing the Longtang dike downstream, opening one li of channel southeast to Shuinian Village, and cutting one li west of Puwu Bridge.

sentences.zh: 上至平山縣西北，下至寧晉縣，疏其淤澱，築堤分其上源入舊河，以殺其勢。

translations.literal: From northwest Pingshan County upstream to Ningjin County downstream, silt deposits were to be dredged and dikes built to divide the upper flow back into the old river and reduce its force.
translations.idiomatic: From northwest Pingshan upstream to Ningjin downstream, silt would be dredged and dikes built to split the upper flow back into the old channel and tame its force.

sentences.zh: 復有程同、程章二石橋阻咽水勢，擬開減水月河二道，可久且便。

translations.literal: The Cheng Tong and Cheng Zhang stone bridges also choked the current; opening two flood-relief channels was proposed as lasting and convenient.
translations.idiomatic: The Cheng Tong and Cheng Zhang stone bridges also blocked the flow; two flood-relief channels were proposed as a durable, practical fix.

sentences.zh: 下相欒城縣，南視趙州寧晉縣，諸河北之下源，地形低下，恐水泛，經欒城、趙州，壞石橋，阻河流為害。

translations.literal: Farther down, looking south from Luancheng County toward Ningjin County in Zhao Prefecture, the lower reaches of the northern rivers lie low. We fear flooding through Luancheng and Zhao Prefecture would destroy stone bridges and obstruct the river to the people's harm.
translations.idiomatic: Farther downstream, from Luancheng south toward Ningjin in Zhao Prefecture, the northern rivers' lower reaches were low-lying. Floods through Luancheng and Zhao Prefecture could wreck stone bridges and choke the channel.

sentences.zh: 由是議於欒城縣北，聖母堂東冶河東岸，開減水河，可去真定之患。」

translations.literal: Therefore it was proposed to open a flood-relief channel north of Luancheng County, east of Shengmu Hall on the Ye River's east bank, which could remove the threat to Zhending."
translations.idiomatic: They proposed opening a flood-relief channel north of Luancheng, east of Shengmu Hall on the Ye's east bank, to lift the threat from Zhending.

sentences.zh: 省準，於二年二月都水監委官與本路及廉訪司官，同詣平山縣相視，會計修治，總計冶河，始自平山縣北關西龍神廟北獨石，通長五千八百六步，共役夫五千，為工十八萬八百七，無風雨妨工，三十六日可畢。

translations.literal: The province approved; in the second month of the second year the Directorate assigned officials to inspect with circuit and surveillance commission officers. The Ye River project in total, from the lone stone north of the Dragon Spirit Temple at Pingshan County's north gate, ran five thousand eight hundred and six paces; five thousand laborers would perform one million eight hundred and seven work-days, completable in thirty-six days without weather delays.
translations.idiomatic: The province approved. In the second month of the following year Directorate officials inspected the site with circuit and surveillance officers. The Ye River work, from the lone stone north of the Dragon Spirit Temple at Pingshan's north gate, ran five thousand eight hundred and six paces; five thousand laborers would log one million eight hundred and seven work-days and could finish in thirty-six fair-weather days.

sentences.zh: 滹沱河

translations.literal: Hutuo River
translations.idiomatic: The Hutuo River

sentences.zh: 滹沱河，源出於西山，在真定路真定縣南一里，經槁城縣北一里，經平山縣北十里，《寰宇記》載經靈壽縣西南二十里。

translations.literal: The Hutuo River rises in the western mountains; one li south of Zhending County in Zhending Circuit, it passes one li north of Gaocheng County and ten li north of Pingshan County. The Universal Gazetteer records it passing twenty li southwest of Lingshou County.
translations.idiomatic: The Hutuo rose in the western hills. It ran one li south of Zhending County, one li north of Gaocheng County, and ten li north of Pingshan County; the Universal Gazetteer places it twenty li southwest of Lingshou County.

sentences.zh: 此河連貫真定諸郡，經流去處，皆曰滹沱水也。

translations.literal: This river runs through all the prefectures of Zhending; wherever it flows it is called Hutuo water.
translations.idiomatic: The river linked the Zhending prefectures; everywhere it ran it was known as Hutuo water.

sentences.zh: 延祐七年十一月，真定路言：「真定縣城南滹沱河，北決堤，浸近城，每歲修築。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the seventh year of Yanyou, Zhending Circuit reported: "South of Zhending County city the Hutuo River's north bank dike has broken, flooding near the city; dikes are rebuilt every year.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the seventh year of Yanyou (1320), Zhending Circuit reported that the Hutuo's north-bank dike south of the county city had breached and was flooding close to town — a stretch rebuilt every year.

sentences.zh: 聞其源本微，與冶河不相通，後二水合，其勢遂猛，屢壞金大堤為患。

translations.literal: We hear that its source was originally slight and did not connect with the Ye River; later the two waters joined and the force became fierce, repeatedly breaking the Jin-era great dike to the people's harm.
translations.idiomatic: Its source had once been modest and separate from the Ye; after the two rivers merged the current grew fierce and repeatedly broke the great Jin-era dike.

sentences.zh: 本路達魯花赤哈散於至元三十年言，準引辟冶河自作一流，滹沱河水十退三四。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Zhiyuan, Circuit Darughachi Hasan reported for approval on opening the Ye River as a separate channel, reducing Hutuo water by three or four tenths.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year of Zhiyuan (1293), Circuit Darughachi Hasan had proposed opening the Ye as a separate channel, which cut Hutuo flow by three or four tenths.

sentences.zh: 至大元年七月，水漂南關百餘家，淤塞冶河口，其水復滹河。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Zhida, water washed away more than a hundred households at the south gate and silted the Ye River mouth; its water returned to the Hutuo.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Zhida (1308), floods swept away more than a hundred households at the south gate and silted the Ye's mouth, sending its water back into the Hutuo.

sentences.zh: 自後歲有潰決之患，略舉大德十年至皇慶元年，節次修堤，用卷掃葦草二百餘萬，官給夫糧備傭直百餘萬錠。

translations.literal: Since then there have been breaches every year. From the tenth year of Dade through the first year of Huangqing, dikes were repaired in sequence, using more than two million fascine bundles of reeds and grass and more than a million ingots in official corvée grain and hire wages.
translations.idiomatic: Breaches followed year after year. From the tenth year of Dade through the first year of Huangqing, repairs consumed more than two million fascine bundles of reeds and grass and more than a million ingots in corvée grain and hire wages.

sentences.zh: 及延祐元年三月至五月，修堤二百七十餘步，其明堂、判官、勉村三處，就用橋木為樁，征夫五百餘人，執役月餘不能畢。

translations.literal: From the third to the fifth month of the first year of Yanyou, two hundred and seventy-odd paces of dike were repaired. At Mingtang, Panguan, and Miancun bridge timbers were used as piles; more than five hundred laborers were conscripted and worked more than a month without finishing.
translations.idiomatic: From the third to the fifth month of the first year of Yanyou, two hundred and seventy-odd paces of dike were rebuilt. At Mingtang, Panguan, and Miancun, bridge timber served as piles; more than five hundred conscripts labored over a month without finishing.

sentences.zh: 近年米價翔貴，民匱於食，有丁者正身應役，單丁者必須募人，人日傭直不下三五貫，前工未畢，後役叠至。

translations.literal: In recent years grain prices have soared and the people lack food. Households with able-bodied men serve in person; single-son households must hire replacements at daily wages of no less than three to five strings. Before one project ended, the next corvée arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Grain prices had soared and food was scarce. Able-bodied men served in person; single-son households had to hire substitutes at three to five strings a day. One job barely ended before the next corvée began.

sentences.zh: 至七月八日，又沖塌李玉飛等莊及木方、胡營等村三處堤，長一千二百四十步，申請委官相視，差夫築月堤。

translations.literal: On the eighth day of the seventh month, dikes three places long — at Li Yufei's village and the villages of Mufang and Huying, totaling one thousand two hundred and forty paces — were washed away. Officials were requested to inspect and assign laborers to build moon dikes.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth day of the seventh month, one thousand two hundred and forty paces of dike at Li Yufei's village and the villages of Mufang and Huying collapsed. The circuit asked for inspectors and laborers to build crescent dikes.

sentences.zh: 延祐二年，本路前總管馬思忽嘗辟冶河，已復湮塞。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yanyou, former circuit chief Masihu had opened the Ye River, but it had again silted shut.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yanyou, former circuit chief Masihu had opened the Ye, but it had silted shut again.

sentences.zh: 今歲霖雨，水溢北岸數處，浸沒田禾。

translations.literal: This year's heavy rains overflowed the north bank in several places and drowned the fields.
translations.idiomatic: This year's rains had overflowed the north bank in several places and drowned the crops.

sentences.zh: 其河元經康家莊村南流，不記歲月，徙於村北。

translations.literal: The river originally ran south of Kangjia Village; at an unrecorded date it shifted north of the village.
translations.idiomatic: The river had once run south of Kangjia Village; at some unrecorded time it shifted to the north.

sentences.zh: 數年修築，皆於堤北取土，故南高北低，水愈就下侵嚙。

translations.literal: For years earth for dike repairs was taken from the north side of the dike, so the south stood high and the north low, and the water pressed ever downward in erosion.
translations.idiomatic: Years of taking fill from the north side of the dike had left the south high and the north low, so the current pressed downward and ate away the bank.

sentences.zh: 西至木方村，東至護城堤，數約二千餘步，比來春，必須修治。

translations.literal: From Mufang Village in the west to the city-protecting dike in the east, roughly more than two thousand paces — by next spring repairs will be essential.
translations.idiomatic: From Mufang Village west to the city-protecting dike east, more than two thousand paces in all would have to be repaired by spring.

sentences.zh: 用樁梢築土堤，亦非永久之計。

translations.literal: Building earthen dikes with piles and brush is likewise no permanent plan.
translations.idiomatic: Earthen dikes of piles and brush were no lasting solution either.

sentences.zh: 若浚木方村南舊湮枯河，引水南流，閘閉北岸河口，於南岸取土築堤，下至合頭村北與本河合，如此去城稍遠，庶可無患。」

translations.literal: If the old silted and dry channel south of Mufang Village is dredged to draw water south, the north-bank mouth is closed with a gate, earth for dikes is taken from the south bank, and dikes are built down to Hetou Village north to rejoin the main river, the city would stand somewhat farther from the water and might be kept safe."
translations.idiomatic: If the old dry channel south of Mufang were dredged to send water south, the north mouth gated shut, and dikes built from south-bank fill down to Hetou Village to rejoin the main stream, the city would stand farther from the river and might be spared.

sentences.zh: 都水監差官相視，截河築堤，闊千餘步，新開古岸，止闊六十步，恐不能制禦千步之勢。

translations.literal: Directorate officials inspected, cut off the river to build dikes more than a thousand paces wide, and opened an old bank only sixty paces wide — feared insufficient to control a thousand-pace force of water.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate inspectors found a thousand-pace cut-off dike planned against an old bank only sixty paces wide — too narrow, they feared, to hold a thousand-pace flood.

sentences.zh: 若於北岸闕破低薄處，比元料，增夫力，葦草卷掃補築，便計葦草丁夫，若令責辦民間，緣今歲旱澇相仍，民食匱乏，擬均料各州縣上中戶，價錢及食米於官錢內支給。

translations.literal: If at broken, low, and thin places on the north bank, compared with original estimates, labor and materials are increased and fascine revetments added, then reeds, grass, and corvée can be calculated. If the people are charged, since drought and flood have followed one another this year and food is scarce, it is proposed to levy upper and middle households in each prefecture and county equally, with cash wages and rice paid from official funds.
translations.idiomatic: They proposed instead to strengthen broken, thin stretches on the north bank with extra labor and fascine revetments. Because drought and flood had left the people short of food, upper and middle households in each county would be assessed equally, with wages and rice paid from official funds.

sentences.zh: 限二月二十日興工，役夫五千，為工十六萬七百一十九，度三十二日可畢。

translations.literal: Work was to begin on the twentieth day of the second month; five thousand laborers would perform one million six hundred and seven thousand one hundred and nineteen work-days, completable in thirty-two days.
translations.idiomatic: Work would start on the twentieth day of the second month: five thousand laborers, one million six hundred and seven thousand one hundred and nineteen work-days, thirty-two days to finish.

sentences.zh: 總計補築滹沱河北岸防水堤十處，長一千九百一十步，高闊不一，計三百四十萬七千七百五十尺，用推掃梯二十五，每梯用大檁三、小檁三，計大小檁一百五十，草三十五萬八百束，葦二十八萬六百四十束，梢柴七千二百束。

translations.literal: In total, ten flood-protection dikes on the Hutuo River's north bank were to be repaired, one thousand nine hundred and ten paces long, of varying height and width, totaling three million four hundred and seven thousand seven hundred and fifty chi; twenty-five revetment frames were needed, each using three large and three small beams — one hundred and fifty beams in all — plus three hundred fifty thousand eight hundred bundles of grass, two hundred eighty thousand six hundred forty bundles of reeds, and seven thousand two hundred bundles of brushwood.
translations.idiomatic: Ten north-bank flood dikes totaling one thousand nine hundred and ten paces — three million four hundred and seven thousand seven hundred and fifty cubic chi, of varying height and width — would need twenty-five revetment frames (one hundred and fifty beams), three hundred fifty thousand eight hundred bundles of grass, two hundred eighty thousand six hundred forty bundles of reeds, and seven thousand two hundred bundles of brushwood.

sentences.zh: 至治元年三月，真定路言：「真定縣滹沱河，每遇水泛，沖堤岸，浸沒民田，已差募丁夫修築，與廉訪司官相視講究，如將木方村南舊堙河道疏辟，導水東南行，閘閉北岸，卻於河南取土，修築至合頭村，合入本河，似望可以民安。」

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Zhizhi, Zhending Circuit reported: "Whenever the Hutuo at Zhending County floods, it breaks dikes and drowns private fields. Corvée laborers have been assigned to repair while surveillance officers inspect and deliberate. If the old silted channel south of Mufang Village is dredged to guide water southeast, the north bank is gated shut, and dikes are built from earth taken south of the river down to Hetou Village to rejoin the main stream, the people may perhaps be kept safe."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Zhizhi (1321), Zhending Circuit reported that Hutuo floods kept breaking dikes and drowning fields. Corvée repairs were under way with surveillance officers reviewing the work. Dredging the old channel south of Mufang to send water southeast, gating the north bank, and building dikes from south-bank fill to Hetou Village might, they hoped, keep the people safe.

sentences.zh: 都水監與真定路官相視議：「夫治水者，行其所無事，蓋以順其性也。

translations.literal: Directorate and Zhending officials inspected and deliberated: "In managing water, one acts where there is no obstruction — this is to follow its nature.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate and Zhending officials inspected and argued that water should be managed by following its nature, not forcing it where it did not wish to go.

sentences.zh: 閘閉滹沱河口，截河築堤一千餘步，開掘故河老岸，闊六十步，長三十餘里，改水東南行流，霖雨之時，水拍兩岸，截河堤堰，阻逆水性，新開故河，止闊六十步，焉能吞授千步之勢？

translations.literal: Closing the Hutuo mouth, cutting the river to build a dike more than a thousand paces long, and opening the old channel bank sixty paces wide for more than thirty li to turn the flow southeast — in rainy season water would beat both banks; the cut-off dike would obstruct the water's nature. How could a new old channel sixty paces wide swallow a thousand-pace force?
translations.idiomatic: Gating the Hutuo, cutting a thousand-pace dike, and opening a sixty-pace old channel for thirty li to turn the flow southeast would make rain-season floods beat both banks while the cut-off dam fought the river's nature. A sixty-pace channel could not absorb a thousand-pace flood.

sentences.zh: 上咽下滯，必致潰決，徒糜官錢，空勞民力。

translations.literal: Water choked above and stalled below would surely breach; official money would be wasted and the people's labor spent for nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Water would choke upstream and stall downstream until the dikes burst — wasting state funds and civilian labor for nothing.

sentences.zh: 若順其自然，將河北岸舊堤比之元料，增添工物，如法卷掃，堅固修築，誠為官民便益。」

translations.literal: If one follows its natural course, adding labor and materials to the old north-bank dike beyond the original estimate and building solid fascine revetments by rule, this would truly benefit officials and people alike."
translations.idiomatic: Following the river's natural course and strengthening the old north-bank dike with extra materials and proper fascine revetments would truly serve both state and people.

sentences.zh: 省準補築滹沱河北岸縷水堤一十處，通長一千九百一十步，役夫五百名，計一十六萬七百三十九工。

translations.literal: The province approved repair of ten spillwater dikes on the Hutuo River's north bank, totaling one thousand nine hundred and ten paces; five hundred laborers would perform one million six hundred and seven thousand three hundred and thirty-nine work-days.
translations.idiomatic: The province approved ten north-bank spillwater dikes totaling one thousand nine hundred and ten paces — five hundred laborers and one million six hundred and seven thousand three hundred and thirty-nine work-days.

sentences.zh: 泰定四年八月七日，省臣奏：「真定路言，滹沱河水連年泛溢為害，都水監、廉訪司、真定路及瀕河州縣官洎耆老會議，其源自五臺諸山來，至平山縣王母村山口下，與平定州娘子廟石泉冶河合。

translations.literal: On the seventh day of the eighth month of the fourth year of Taiding, provincial officials memorialized: "Zhending Circuit reports that the Hutuo has flooded year after year. The Directorate of Waterworks, the surveillance commission, Zhending Circuit, officials of riparian prefectures and counties, and elders conferred. Its source comes from the Wutai mountains; below Wangmu Village pass in Pingshan County it joins the Ye River from the Niangzi Temple spring at Pingding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh day of the eighth month of the fourth year of Taiding (1327), provincial officials reported Zhending Circuit's plea: the Hutuo had flooded year after year. The Directorate, surveillance commission, circuit officers, riparian counties, and elders had met. The river rose in the Wutai hills and, below Wangmu Village pass in Pingshan, joined the Ye from Pingding Prefecture's Niangzi Temple spring.

sentences.zh: 夏秋霖雨水漲，彌漫城郭，每年勞民築堤，莫能除害，宜自王子村、辛安村鑿河，長四里餘，接魯家灣舊澗，復開二百餘步，合入冶河，以分殺其勢。

translations.literal: Summer and autumn rains swell it until it spreads through the cities. Every year the people are exhausted building dikes yet the harm cannot be removed. A channel should be cut from Wangzi Village and Xin'an Village, more than four li long, connecting with the old gully at Lujiawan; opening two hundred-odd paces farther would join the Ye River and divide and reduce its force.
translations.idiomatic: Summer and autumn rains sent it spreading through the towns. Annual dike work exhausted the people without ending the floods. They proposed cutting a channel from Wangzi and Xin'an villages, more than four li long, into the old gully at Lujiawan and opening two hundred paces farther to join the Ye and split the current.

sentences.zh: 又木方村滹沱河南岸故道，疏滌三十里，北岸下樁卷掃，築堤捍水，令東流。

translations.literal: Also, the old course on the Hutuo's south bank at Mufang Village should be dredged for thirty li; on the north bank piles and fascines should build dikes to hold the water and keep it flowing east.
translations.idiomatic: They also proposed dredging thirty li of the old south-bank course at Mufang and building north-bank pile-and-fascine dikes to hold the river eastward.

sentences.zh: 今歲儲材，九月興役，期十一月功成。

translations.literal: Materials would be stockpiled this year; labor would begin in the ninth month, with completion expected in the eleventh month.
translations.idiomatic: Materials would be gathered this year, work would start in the ninth month, and the project would finish in the eleventh.

sentences.zh: 所用石鐵石灰諸物，夫匠工糧，官為供給，力省功多，可永無害。

translations.literal: Stone, iron, lime, and other materials, craftsmen's wages and rations would be supplied by the state — less labor for greater effect, and lasting safety.
translations.idiomatic: Stone, iron, lime, craftsmen's wages, and rations would come from the state — more work for less toil, they argued, and lasting safety.

sentences.zh: 工部議，若從所請，二河並治，役大民勞，擬先開冶河，其真定路征民夫，如不敷，可於鄰郡順德路差募人夫，日給中統鈔一兩五錢，如侵礙民田，官酬其直。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Works deliberated: if the request were granted, treating both rivers at once would mean great labor and weary the people. It was proposed to open the Ye River first; if Zhending Circuit's conscripted laborers were insufficient, hired labor could be drawn from neighboring Shunde Circuit at one liang and five qian of Zhongtong cash per day; if private fields were affected, the state would compensate their value.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Works replied that doing both rivers at once would overtax the people. Open the Ye first, they said; if Zhending's corvée fell short, hire labor from neighboring Shunde Circuit at one liang five qian of Zhongtong cash a day and compensate any farmland taken.

sentences.zh: 中書省都水監差官，率知水利濠寨，督本路及當該州縣用工，廉訪司添力咸就，滹河近後再議。」

translations.literal: Directorate officials would lead waterworks garrison officers who know hydraulics to supervise labor in this circuit and the relevant prefectures and counties; the surveillance commission would add its strength until all was done; the Hutuo would be reconsidered afterward."
translations.idiomatic: Directorate officers would lead skilled garrison hydraulics officers to supervise the circuit and counties; the surveillance commission would lend force until the work was done; the Hutuo project would wait.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was approved.

sentences.zh: 九月，委都水監官洎本道廉訪司真定路同監督有司並工修治。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Directorate officials together with the circuit surveillance commission and Zhending Circuit were assigned to supervise local offices in joint repair work.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Directorate officials, the surveillance commission, and Zhending Circuit were ordered to supervise local offices in the joint repair.

sentences.zh: 後真定路言：「閏九月五日為始興工間，據趙州臨城諸縣申，天寒地凍，難於用工，候春暖開闢便，已於十月七日放散人民。」

translations.literal: Later Zhending Circuit reported: "Work began on the fifth day of the intercalary ninth month, but Zhao Prefecture, Lincheng, and other counties reported that cold and frozen ground made labor difficult; when spring warmth came opening would be easier. Laborers were dismissed on the seventh day of the tenth month."
translations.idiomatic: Zhending Circuit later reported that work had begun on the fifth day of the intercalary ninth month, but Zhao Prefecture, Lincheng, and other counties said frozen ground made labor impossible and asked to wait for spring. The workers were sent home on the seventh day of the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 部議，人夫既散，宜準所擬。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated: since the laborers had been dismissed, the proposed plan should be approved.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry agreed that with the laborers gone, the spring delay should stand.

sentences.zh: 凡已給夫鈔二萬六千八百三十二錠，地價錢六百三十錠。

translations.literal: In all, corvée cash already issued totaled twenty-six thousand eight hundred and thirty-two ingots, and land compensation six hundred and thirty ingots.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée cash already paid totaled twenty-six thousand eight hundred and thirty-two ingots; land compensation, six hundred and thirty.

sentences.zh: 會通河

translations.literal: Huitong River
translations.idiomatic: The Huitong River

sentences.zh: 會通河，起東昌路須城縣安山之西南，由壽張西北至東昌，又西北至於臨清，以逾於御河。

translations.literal: The Huitong River begins southwest of Anshan in Xucheng County, Dongchang Circuit, runs northwest through Shouzhang to Dongchang, then northwest to Linqing, and crosses into the Imperial River.
translations.idiomatic: The Huitong River began southwest of Anshan in Xucheng County, Dongchang Circuit, ran northwest through Shouzhang and Dongchang to Linqing, and crossed into the Imperial River.

sentences.zh: 至元二十六年，壽張縣尹韓仲暉、太史院令史邊源相繼建言，開河置閘，引汶水達舟於御河，以便公私漕販。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan, Shouzhang County magistrate Han Zhonghui and Astrological Commission clerk Bian Yuan successively proposed opening a canal with locks to draw Wen River water so boats could reach the Imperial River, easing public and private grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan (1289), Shouzhang magistrate Han Zhonghui and Astrological Commission clerk Bian Yuan proposed in turn a canal with locks to bring Wen River water to the Imperial River for public and private shipping.

sentences.zh: 省遣漕副馬之貞與源等按視地勢，商度工用，於是圖上可開之狀。

translations.literal: The province sent Transport Vice Commissioner Ma Zhizhen with Yuan and others to inspect the terrain and estimate labor; they then mapped the feasible route.
translations.idiomatic: The province sent Transport Vice Commissioner Ma Zhizhen with Yuan and others to survey the ground, estimate costs, and map a workable route.

sentences.zh: 詔出楮幣一百五十萬緡、米四萬石、鹽五萬斤，以為傭直，備器用，征旁郡丁夫三萬，驛遣斷事官忙速兒、禮部尚書張孔孫、兵部尚書李處巽等董其役。

translations.literal: An edict issued one million five hundred thousand strings of paper cash, forty thousand shi of rice, and fifty thousand jin of salt for hire wages and equipment; thirty thousand corvée laborers were conscripted from neighboring circuits, and investigating officials Masu'er, Minister of Rites Zhang Kongsun, and Minister of War Li Chuxun were dispatched by post to direct the work.
translations.idiomatic: The court allocated one million five hundred thousand strings of paper cash, forty thousand shi of rice, and fifty thousand jin of salt for wages and tools, conscripted thirty thousand corvée laborers from neighboring circuits, and posted investigating officials Masu'er, Minister of Rites Zhang Kongsun, and Minister of War Li Chuxun to direct the project.

sentences.zh: 首事於是年正月己亥，起於須城安山之西南，止於臨清之御河，其長二百五十餘里，中建閘三十有一，度高低，分遠邇，以節蓄泄。

translations.literal: Work began on the jihai day of the first month of that year, from southwest of Anshan in Xucheng to the Imperial River at Linqing — more than two hundred and fifty li in length — with thirty-one locks built midway, gauging height and distance to regulate storage and discharge.
translations.idiomatic: Work began on the jihai day of the first month that year, from southwest of Anshan in Xucheng to the Imperial River at Linqing — more than two hundred and fifty li — with thirty-one locks spaced by height and distance to hold and release water.

sentences.zh: 六月辛亥成，凡役工二百五十一萬七百四十有八，賜名曰會通河。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day of the sixth month it was completed. Total labor was two million five hundred ten thousand seven hundred and forty-eight work-days. It was given the name Huitong River.
translations.idiomatic: It was finished on the xinhai day of the sixth month after two million five hundred ten thousand seven hundred and forty-eight work-days. The canal was named the Huitong River.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，省以馬之貞言霖雨岸崩，河道淤淺，宜加修浚，奏撥放罷輸運站戶三千，專供其役，仍俾采伐木石等以充用。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, the province, on Ma Zhizhen's report that rains had collapsed the banks and silted the channel, proposed dredging and repair. Three thousand grain-transport station households slated for release were assigned exclusively to this labor, with permission to cut timber and quarry stone for materials.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, after Ma Zhizhen reported rain-wrecked banks and a silted channel, the province ordered dredging and repair. Three thousand grain-transport station households marked for release were kept on the project and allowed to cut timber and quarry stone.

sentences.zh: 是後，歲委都水監官一員，佩分監印，率令史、奏差、濠寨官往職巡視，且督工，易閘以石，而視所損緩急為後先。

translations.literal: Thereafter each year one Directorate official bearing a deputy seal, leading clerks, memorial couriers, and garrison officers, was sent on patrol to supervise work, replacing wooden locks with stone and prioritizing repairs by damage.
translations.idiomatic: Each year afterward a sealed Directorate deputy led clerks, couriers, and garrison officers on patrol to supervise repairs, swap wooden locks for stone, and tackle the worst damage first.

sentences.zh: 至泰定二年，始克畢事。

translations.literal: Only in the second year of Taiding was the work fully completed.
translations.idiomatic: The work was not fully finished until the second year of Taiding (1325).

sentences.zh: 會通鎮閘三、土壩二，在臨清縣北。

translations.literal: At Huitong Town there are three locks and two earthen dams, north of Linqing County.
translations.idiomatic: Huitong Town had three locks and two earthen dams north of Linqing County.

sentences.zh: 頭閘長一百尺，闊八十尺，兩直身各長四十尺，兩雁翅各斜長三十尺，高二尺，閘空闊二丈，自至元三十年正月一日興工，凡役夫匠六百六十名，至十月二十九日工畢。

translations.literal: The head lock is one hundred chi long and eighty chi wide; each straight flank is forty chi long and each sloping wing thirty chi; height two chi; lock opening two zhang wide. Work began on the first day of the first month of the thirtieth year of Zhiyuan; six hundred and sixty craftsmen and laborers in all; completed on the twenty-ninth day of the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: The head lock measured one hundred by eighty chi, with forty-chi straight flanks and thirty-chi sloping wings, two chi high and two zhang wide at the opening. Work began on the first day of the first month of the thirtieth year of Zhiyuan (1293); six hundred and sixty workers finished on the twenty-ninth day of the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 中閘南至隘船閘三里，元貞二年七月二十三日興工，至大德二年三月十三日工畢，夫匠四百四十三，長廣與上閘同。

translations.literal: From the middle lock south to the Narrow-Boat Lock is three li. Work began on the twenty-third day of the seventh month of the second year of Yuanzhen; completed on the thirteenth day of the third month of the second year of Dade; four hundred and forty-three craftsmen and laborers; length and width the same as the upper lock.
translations.idiomatic: The middle lock stood three li north of the Narrow-Boat Lock. Work ran from the twenty-third day of the seventh month of the second year of Yuanzhen (1296) to the thirteenth day of the third month of the second year of Dade (1298) with four hundred and forty-three workers; dimensions matched the upper lock.

sentences.zh: 隘船閘南至李海務閘一百五十二里，延祐元年八月十五日興工，九月二十五日工畢，夫匠五百，閘空闊九尺，長廣同上。

translations.literal: From the Narrow-Boat Lock south to the Lihaiwu Lock is one hundred and fifty-two li. Work began on the fifteenth day of the eighth month of the first year of Yanyou; completed on the twenty-fifth day of the ninth month; five hundred craftsmen and laborers; lock opening nine chi wide; length and width as above.
translations.idiomatic: The Narrow-Boat Lock lay one hundred and fifty-two li north of the Lihaiwu Lock. Built from the fifteenth day of the eighth month to the twenty-fifth day of the ninth month of the first year of Yanyou (1314) by five hundred workers, it had a nine-chi opening and the same length and width as above.

sentences.zh: 土壩二。

translations.literal: Two earthen dams.
translations.idiomatic: There were two earthen dams.

sentences.zh: 李海務閘南至周家店閘一十二里，元貞二年二月二日興工，五月二十日工畢，夫匠五百二十七名，長廣與會通鎮閘同。

translations.literal: From the Lihaiwu Lock south to the Zhoujiadian Lock is twelve li. Work began on the second day of the second month of the second year of Yuanzhen; completed on the twentieth day of the fifth month; five hundred and twenty-seven craftsmen and laborers; length and width the same as the Huitong Town locks.
translations.idiomatic: The Lihaiwu Lock stood twelve li north of the Zhoujiadian Lock. Work ran from the second day of the second month to the twentieth day of the fifth month of the second year of Yuanzhen with five hundred and twenty-seven workers; dimensions matched the Huitong Town locks.

sentences.zh: 周家店閘南至七級閘一十二里，大德四年正月二十一日興工，八月二十日工畢，夫匠四百四十二，長廣與上同。

translations.literal: From the Zhoujiadian Lock south to the Seven-Stage Lock is twelve li. Work began on the twenty-first day of the first month of the fourth year of Dade; completed on the twentieth day of the eighth month; four hundred and forty-two craftsmen and laborers; length and width as above.
translations.idiomatic: Zhoujiadian stood twelve li north of the Seven-Stage Lock. Built from the twenty-first day of the first month to the twentieth day of the eighth month of the fourth year of Dade (1300) by four hundred and forty-two workers; dimensions as above.

sentences.zh: 七級閘二：北閘南至南閘三里，大德元年五月一日興工，十月六日工畢，夫匠四百四十三名，長廣如周家店閘。

translations.literal: The Seven-Stage Lock has two parts: from the north lock south to the south lock is three li. Work began on the first day of the fifth month of the first year of Dade; completed on the sixth day of the tenth month; four hundred and forty-three craftsmen and laborers; length and width like the Zhoujiadian Lock.
translations.idiomatic: The Seven-Stage Lock came in two parts three li apart. The north section was built from the first day of the fifth month to the sixth day of the tenth month of the first year of Dade (1297) by four hundred and forty-three workers; dimensions matched Zhoujiadian.

sentences.zh: 南閘南至阿城閘一十二里，元貞二年正月二十日興工，十月五日工畢，夫匠四百五十名，長廣同北閘。

translations.literal: From the south lock south to the Acheng Lock is twelve li. Work began on the twentieth day of the first month of the second year of Yuanzhen; completed on the fifth day of the tenth month; four hundred and fifty craftsmen and laborers; length and width the same as the north lock.
translations.idiomatic: The south section stood twelve li north of the Acheng Lock. Built from the twentieth day of the first month to the fifth day of the tenth month of the second year of Yuanzhen by four hundred and fifty workers; dimensions matched the north lock.

sentences.zh: 阿城閘二：北閘南至南閘三里，大德三年三月五日興工，七月二十八日工畢，夫匠四百四十一名，長廣上同。

translations.literal: The Acheng Lock has two parts: from the north lock south to the south lock is three li. Work began on the fifth day of the third month of the third year of Dade; completed on the twenty-eighth day of the seventh month; four hundred and forty-one craftsmen and laborers; length and width as above.
translations.idiomatic: The Acheng Lock also had north and south sections three li apart. Built from the fifth day of the third month to the twenty-eighth day of the seventh month of the third year of Dade (1299) by four hundred and forty-one workers; dimensions as above.

sentences.zh: 南閘南至荊門北閘一十里，大德二年正月二十五日興工，十月一日工畢，夫匠四百四十六名，長廣上同。

translations.literal: From the south lock south to the north lock at Jingmen is ten li. Work began on the twenty-fifth day of the first month of the second year of Dade; completed on the first day of the tenth month; four hundred and forty-six craftsmen and laborers; length and width as above.
translations.idiomatic: The south section stood ten li north of Jingmen's north lock. Built from the twenty-fifth day of the first month to the first day of the tenth month of the second year of Dade by four hundred and forty-six workers; dimensions as above.

sentences.zh: 荊門閘二：北閘南至荊門南閘二里半，大德三年六月初一日興工，至十月二十五日工畢，役夫三百一十名，長廣同。

translations.literal: The Jingmen Lock has two parts: from the north lock south to the south lock at Jingmen is two and a half li. Work began on the first day of the sixth month of the third year of Dade; completed on the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month; three hundred and ten laborers; length and width the same.
translations.idiomatic: Jingmen's north and south locks lay two and a half li apart. Built from the first day of the sixth month to the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month of the third year of Dade by three hundred and ten workers; same dimensions.

sentences.zh: 南閘南至壽張閘六十三里，大德六年正月二十三日興工，六月二十九日工畢，長廣同北閘。

translations.literal: From the south lock south to the Shouzhang Lock is sixty-three li. Work began on the twenty-third day of the first month of the sixth year of Dade; completed on the twenty-ninth day of the sixth month; length and width the same as the north lock.
translations.idiomatic: The south lock stood sixty-three li north of the Shouzhang Lock. Built from the twenty-third day of the first month to the twenty-ninth day of the sixth month of the sixth year of Dade; dimensions matched the north lock.

sentences.zh: 壽張閘南至安山閘八里，至元三十一年正月一日興工，五月二十日工畢。

translations.literal: From the Shouzhang Lock south to the Anshan Lock is eight li. Work began on the first day of the first month of the thirty-first year of Zhiyuan; completed on the twentieth day of the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: Shouzhang stood eight li north of the Anshan Lock. Work ran from the first day of the first month to the twentieth day of the fifth month of the thirty-first year of Zhiyuan (1294).

sentences.zh: 安山閘南至開河閘八十五里，至元二十六年建。

translations.literal: From the Anshan Lock south to the Canal-Opening Lock is eighty-five li. Built in the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Anshan stood eighty-five li north of the Canal-Opening Lock, built in the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan (1289).

sentences.zh: 開河閘南至濟州閘一百二十四里。

translations.literal: From the Canal-Opening Lock south to the Jizhou Lock is one hundred and twenty-four li.
translations.idiomatic: The Canal-Opening Lock stood one hundred and twenty-four li north of the Jizhou Lock.

sentences.zh: 濟州閘三：上閘南至中閘三里，大德元年三月十二日興工，七月二十八日工畢。

translations.literal: The Jizhou Lock has three parts: from the upper lock south to the middle lock is three li. Work began on the twelfth day of the third month of the first year of Dade; completed on the twenty-eighth day of the seventh month.
translations.idiomatic: The Jizhou Lock had three sections; the upper stood three li north of the middle. Built from the twelfth day of the third month to the twenty-eighth day of the seventh month of the first year of Dade.

sentences.zh: 中閘南至下閘二里，至治元年三月一日興工，六月六日工畢。

translations.literal: From the middle lock south to the lower lock is two li. Work began on the first day of the third month of the first year of Zhizhi; completed on the sixth day of the sixth month.
translations.idiomatic: The middle lock stood two li north of the lower. Built from the first day of the third month to the sixth day of the sixth month of the first year of Zhizhi (1321).

sentences.zh: 下閘南至趙村閘六里，大德七年二月十三日興工，五月二十一日工畢。

translations.literal: From the lower lock south to the Zhaocun Lock is six li. Work began on the thirteenth day of the second month of the seventh year of Dade; completed on the twenty-first day of the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: The lower lock stood six li north of the Zhaocun Lock. Built from the thirteenth day of the second month to the twenty-first day of the fifth month of the seventh year of Dade (1303).

sentences.zh: 趙村閘南至石佛閘七里，泰定四年二月十八日興工，五月二十日工畢。

translations.literal: From the Zhaocun Lock south to the Shifo Lock is seven li. Work began on the eighteenth day of the second month of the fourth year of Taiding; completed on the twentieth day of the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaocun stood seven li north of the Shifo Lock. Built from the eighteenth day of the second month to the twentieth day of the fifth month of the fourth year of Taiding (1327).

sentences.zh: 石佛閘南至辛店閘一十三里，延祐六年二月十日興工，四月二十九日工畢。

translations.literal: From the Shifo Lock south to the Xindian Lock is thirteen li. Work began on the tenth day of the second month of the sixth year of Yanyou; completed on the twenty-ninth day of the fourth month.
translations.idiomatic: Shifo stood thirteen li north of the Xindian Lock. Built from the tenth day of the second month to the twenty-ninth day of the fourth month of the sixth year of Yanyou (1319).

sentences.zh: 辛店閘南至師家店閘二十四里，大德元年正月二十七日興工，四月一日工畢。

translations.literal: From the Xindian Lock south to the Shijiadian Lock is twenty-four li. Work began on the twenty-seventh day of the first month of the first year of Dade; completed on the first day of the fourth month.
translations.idiomatic: Xindian stood twenty-four li north of the Shijiadian Lock. Built from the twenty-seventh day of the first month to the first day of the fourth month of the first year of Dade (1297).

sentences.zh: 師家店閘南至棗林閘一十五里，大德二年二月三日興工，五月二十三日工畢。

translations.literal: From the Shijiadian Lock south to the Zaolin Lock is fifteen li. Work began on the third day of the second month of the second year of Dade; completed on the twenty-third day of the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: Shijiadian stood fifteen li north of the Zaolin Lock. Built from the third day of the second month to the twenty-third day of the fifth month of the second year of Dade (1298).

sentences.zh: 棗林閘南至孟陽泊閘九十五里，延祐五年二月四日興工，五月二十二日工畢。

translations.literal: From the Zaolin Lock south to the Mengyangbo Lock is ninety-five li. Work began on the fourth day of the second month of the fifth year of Yanyou; completed on the twenty-second day of the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: Zaolin stood ninety-five li north of the Mengyangbo Lock. Built from the fourth day of the second month to the twenty-second day of the fifth month of the fifth year of Yanyou (1318).

sentences.zh: 孟陽泊閘南至金溝閘九十里，大德八年正月四日興工，五月十七日工畢。

translations.literal: From the Mengyangbo Lock south to the Jingou Lock is ninety li. Work began on the fourth day of the first month of the eighth year of Dade; completed on the seventeenth day of the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: Mengyangbo stood ninety li north of the Jingou Lock. Built from the fourth day of the first month to the seventeenth day of the fifth month of the eighth year of Dade (1304).

sentences.zh: 金溝閘南至隘船閘一十二里，大德十年閏正月二十五日興工，四月二十三日工畢。

translations.literal: From the Jingou Lock south to the Narrow-Boat Lock is twelve li. Work began on the twenty-fifth day of the intercalary first month of the tenth year of Dade; completed on the twenty-third day of the fourth month.
translations.idiomatic: Jingou stood twelve li north of the Narrow-Boat Lock. Built from the twenty-fifth day of the intercalary first month to the twenty-third day of the fourth month of the tenth year of Dade (1306).

sentences.zh: 沽頭閘二：北隘船閘南至下閘二里，延祐二年二月六日興工，五月十五日工畢。

translations.literal: The Gutou Lock has two parts: from the north Narrow-Boat Lock south to the lower lock is two li. Work began on the sixth day of the second month of the second year of Yanyou; completed on the fifteenth day of the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: The Gutou Lock had two sections: the north Narrow-Boat Lock stood two li north of the lower lock. Built from the sixth day of the second month to the fifteenth day of the fifth month of the second year of Yanyou (1315).

sentences.zh: 南閘南至徐州一百二十里，大德十一年二月興工，五月十四日工畢。

translations.literal: From the south lock south to Xuzhou is one hundred and twenty li. Work began in the second month of the eleventh year of Dade; completed on the fourteenth day of the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: The south lock stood one hundred and twenty li north of Xuzhou. Work began in the second month and finished on the fourteenth day of the fifth month of the eleventh year of Dade (1307).

sentences.zh: 三汊口閘入鹽河，南至土山閘一十八里，泰定二年正月十九日興工，四月十三日工畢。

translations.literal: The Sanchakou Lock enters the Salt River; south to the Tushan Lock is eighteen li. Work began on the nineteenth day of the first month of the second year of Taiding; completed on the thirteenth day of the fourth month.
translations.idiomatic: The Sanchakou Lock connected to the Salt River, standing eighteen li north of the Tushan Lock. Built from the nineteenth day of the first month to the thirteenth day of the fourth month of the second year of Taiding (1325).

sentences.zh: 土山閘南至三汊口閘二十五里，入鹽河。

translations.literal: From the Tushan Lock south to the Sanchakou Lock is twenty-five li; it enters the Salt River.
translations.idiomatic: Tushan stood twenty-five li north of the Sanchakou Lock and connected to the Salt River.

sentences.zh: 兗州閘。

translations.literal: The Yanzhou Lock.
translations.idiomatic: There was the Yanzhou Lock.

sentences.zh: 堈城閘。

translations.literal: The Gangcheng Lock.
translations.idiomatic: There was the Gangcheng Lock.

sentences.zh: 延祐元年二月二十日，省臣言：「江南行省起運諸物，皆由會通河以達於都，為其河淺澀，大船充塞於其中，阻礙余船不得來往。

translations.literal: On the twentieth day of the second month of the first year of Yanyou, provincial officials reported: "The Jiangnan Branch Secretariat ships all tribute goods via the Huitong Canal to the capital. Because the river is shallow and sluggish, large vessels choke it and block other boats from passing.
translations.idiomatic: On the twentieth day of the second month of the first year of Yanyou (1314), provincial officials reported that the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat shipped all tribute goods to the capital via the Huitong Canal. The river had grown shallow and sluggish, and large vessels packed it so tightly that other boats could not get through.

sentences.zh: 每歲省臺差人巡視，其所差官言，始開河時，止許行百五十料船，近年權勢之人，並富商大賈，貪嗜貨利，造三四百料或五百料船，於此河行駕，以致阻滯官民舟楫，如於沽頭置小石閘一，止許行百五十料船便。

translations.literal: Each year the provincial and central secretariats send inspectors. Those officials say that when the river was first opened, only one-hundred-and-fifty-material boats were permitted. In recent years powerful persons and wealthy merchants, greedy for profit, have built three- or four-hundred-material or even five-hundred-material boats to sail this river, obstructing official and private traffic. Placing a small stone lock at Gutou to limit passage to one-hundred-and-fifty-material boats would suffice.
translations.idiomatic: Each year the provincial and central secretariats sent inspectors. Those officials reported that when the canal was first opened, only boats of one hundred and fifty materials were allowed. In recent years powerful men and wealthy merchants, greedy for profit, had built boats of three or four hundred materials, even five hundred, to sail this river, blocking official and private traffic alike. A small stone lock at Gutou, limiting passage to one-hundred-and-fifty-material boats, would solve the problem.

sentences.zh: 臣等議，宜依所言，中書及都水監差官於沽頭置小閘一，及於臨清相視宜置閘處，亦置小閘一，禁約二百料之上船，不許入河行運。」

translations.literal: We propose adopting this advice: let the Central Secretariat and the Directorate of Waterways dispatch officials to place a small lock at Gutou, and after inspecting suitable sites at Linqing, place another small lock there as well, forbidding boats of more than two hundred materials from entering the river for transport."
translations.idiomatic: We propose adopting this plan: let the Central Secretariat and the Directorate of Waterways dispatch officials to place a small lock at Gutou, and after inspecting suitable sites at Linqing, place another small lock there as well, forbidding boats of more than two hundred materials from entering the canal for transport.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 至治三年四月十日，都水分監言：「會通河沛縣東金溝、沽頭諸處，地形高峻，旱則水淺舟澀，省部已準置二滾水堰。

translations.literal: On the tenth day of the fourth month of the third year of Zhizhi, the Branch Directorate of Waterways reported: "At Jingou, Gutou, and other places east of Pei County on the Huitong Canal, the terrain is high and steep; in drought the water runs shallow and boats stall. The provincial authorities have already approved two overflow weirs.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth day of the fourth month of the third year of Zhizhi (1323), the Branch Directorate of Waterways reported that at Jingou, Gutou, and other places east of Pei County on the Huitong Canal, the terrain was high and steep; in drought the water ran shallow and boats stalled. The provincial authorities had already approved two overflow weirs.

sentences.zh: 近延祐二年，沽頭閘上增置隘閘一，以限巨舟，每經霖雨，則三閘月河、截河土堰，盡為沖決。

translations.literal: Recently, in the second year of Yanyou, a restrictive lock was added above the Gutou Lock to limit large boats. Whenever heavy rains come, the three locks' bypass channels and the cross-river earthen dams are all breached.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, in the second year of Yanyou (1315), a restrictive lock had been added above the Gutou Lock to limit large boats. Whenever heavy rains came, the bypass channels of all three locks and the cross-river earthen dams were washed away.

sentences.zh: 自秋摘夫刈薪，至冬水落，或來歲春首修治，工夫浩大，動用丁夫千百，束薪十萬之余，數月方完，勞費萬倍。

translations.literal: From autumn labor is requisitioned to cut firewood; by winter when the water falls, or at the start of the following spring, repairs begin. The work is enormous—thousands of corvée laborers and more than a hundred thousand bundles of firewood—and takes months to finish, at ten thousand times the usual labor and expense.
translations.idiomatic: From autumn corvée laborers were requisitioned to cut firewood; by winter when the water fell, or at the start of the following spring, repairs began. The work was enormous—thousands of laborers and more than a hundred thousand bundles of firewood—and took months to finish, at ten thousand times the usual labor and expense.

sentences.zh: 又況延祐六年雨多水溢，月河、土堰及石閘雁翅日被沖嚙，土石相離，深及數丈，其工倍多，至今未完。

translations.literal: Moreover, in the sixth year of Yanyou heavy rains caused flooding; bypass channels, earthen dams, and the stone wings of the locks were eroded day by day until earth and stone parted to depths of several zhang. The repairs needed were twice as great and remain unfinished to this day.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in the sixth year of Yanyou (1319) heavy rains caused flooding; bypass channels, earthen dams, and the stone wings of the locks were eroded day by day until earth and stone parted to depths of several zhang. The repairs needed were twice as great and remained unfinished to this day.

sentences.zh: 今若運金溝、沽頭並隘閘三處見有石，於沽頭月河內修堰閘一所，更將隘閘移置金溝閘月河、或沽頭閘月河內，水大則大閘俱開，使水得通流，小則閉金溝大閘，上開隘閘，沽頭則閉隘閘，而啟正閘行舟。

translations.literal: If we now transport the stone already on hand at Jingou, Gutou, and the restrictive lock, build one dam-lock in the Gutou bypass channel, and move the restrictive lock to the bypass channel of either the Jingou or Gutou lock: when the water is high, open all the main locks so water can flow freely; when it is low, close the main Jingou lock, open the restrictive lock above it, and at Gutou close the restrictive lock and open the main lock for boats.
translations.idiomatic: If the stone already on hand at Jingou, Gutou, and the restrictive lock were now used to build one dam-lock in the Gutou bypass channel, and the restrictive lock were moved to the bypass channel of either the Jingou or Gutou lock: when water was high, all main locks could open so water flowed freely; when it was low, the main Jingou lock would close, the restrictive lock above it would open, and at Gutou the restrictive lock would close while the main lock opened for boats.

sentences.zh: 如此歲省修治之費，亦可免丁夫冬寒入水之苦，誠為一勞永逸。」

translations.literal: In this way annual repair costs would be saved and corvée laborers spared the misery of working in freezing water—a true case of one effort bringing lasting ease."
translations.idiomatic: In this way annual repair costs would be saved and corvée laborers spared the misery of working in freezing water—a true case of one effort bringing lasting ease.

sentences.zh: 移文工部，令委官與有司同議。

translations.literal: A dispatch was sent to the Ministry of Works ordering delegated officials to consult with local authorities.
translations.idiomatic: A dispatch was sent to the Ministry of Works ordering delegated officials to consult with local authorities.

sentences.zh: 於是差濠寨約會濟寧路官相視，就問金溝閘提領周德興，言每歲夏秋霖雨，沖失閘堤，必候水落，役夫采薪修治，不下三兩月方畢，冬寒水作，苦不勝言。

translations.literal: Officials were then dispatched from the river garrison to meet with Jining Circuit officers for inspection. They questioned Zhou Dexing, chief of the Jingou Lock, who said that every year during the summer and autumn rains the lock embankments were washed away; repair had to wait for the water to fall, then laborers gathered firewood for repairs—a process taking at least two or three months, with misery beyond words when icy water rose in winter.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were then dispatched from the river garrison to meet with Jining Circuit officers for inspection. They questioned Zhou Dexing, chief of the Jingou Lock, who reported that every summer and autumn the lock embankments were washed away in the rains. Repairs had to wait for the water to fall, then laborers gathered firewood for the work—a process taking at least two or three months, with misery beyond words when icy water rose in winter.

sentences.zh: 會驗監察御史言：「延祐初，元省臣亦嘗請置隘閘以限巨舟，臣等議，其言當，請從之。」

translations.literal: Upon review the censor reported: "At the beginning of Yanyou the former provincial officials also requested a restrictive lock to limit large boats. We find their proposal correct and ask that it be adopted."
translations.idiomatic: Upon review the censor reported that at the beginning of Yanyou the former provincial officials had also requested a restrictive lock to limit large boats. The censors found the proposal correct and asked that it be adopted.

sentences.zh: 於是議：梭板等船乃御河、江、淮可行之物，宜遣出任其所之，於金溝、沽頭兩閘中置隘閘二，各闊一丈，以限大船。

translations.literal: It was then resolved that shuttle-board boats and the like were fit for the Imperial Canal and the Yangtze-Huai routes and should be sent wherever they belonged; two restrictive locks should be placed between the Jingou and Gutou locks, each one zhang wide, to limit large boats.
translations.idiomatic: It was then resolved that shuttle-board boats and the like were fit for the Imperial Canal and the Yangtze-Huai routes and should be sent wherever they belonged. Two restrictive locks would be placed between the Jingou and Gutou locks, each one zhang wide, to limit large boats.

sentences.zh: 若欲於通惠、會通河行運者，止許一百五十料，違者罪之，仍沒其船。

translations.literal: Boats wishing to transport on the Tonghui and Huitong canals would be limited to one hundred and fifty materials; violators would be punished and their vessels confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Boats wishing to transport on the Tonghui and Huitong canals would be limited to one hundred and fifty materials; violators would be punished and their vessels confiscated.

sentences.zh: 其大都、江南權勢紅頭花船，一體不許來往，準擬拆移沽頭隘閘，置於金溝大閘之南，仍作運環閘，其間空地北作滾水石堰，水漲即開大小三閘，水落即鎖閉大閘，止於隘閘通舟。

translations.literal: Powerful pleasure boats from the capital and Jiangnan with red prows and floral decoration would likewise be barred. The plan was to dismantle and move the Gutou restrictive lock south of the Jingou main lock, making a transit ring-lock; on the empty ground to the north build a stone overflow weir—when water rose, open all three locks large and small; when it fell, seal the main lock and allow boats through only the restrictive lock.
translations.idiomatic: Powerful pleasure boats from the capital and Jiangnan with red prows and floral decoration would likewise be barred. The plan was to dismantle and move the Gutou restrictive lock south of the Jingou main lock, making a transit ring-lock. On the empty ground to the north a stone overflow weir would be built: when water rose, all three locks large and small would open; when it fell, the main lock would be sealed and boats would pass only through the restrictive lock.

sentences.zh: 果有小料船及官用巨物，許申稟上司，權開大閘，仍添金溝閘板積水，以便行舟。
