translations.literal: If small-material boats or official heavy cargo truly needed passage, they could petition superiors for temporary opening of the main lock and additional lock boards at Jingou to store water for navigation.
translations.idiomatic: If small-material boats or official heavy cargo truly needed passage, they could petition superiors for temporary opening of the main lock and additional lock boards at Jingou to store water for navigation.

sentences.zh: 其沽頭截河土堰，依例改修石堰，盡除舊有土堰三道。

translations.literal: The cross-river earthen dam at Gutou would be rebuilt as a stone dam per precedent, and all three former earthen dams removed.
translations.idiomatic: The cross-river earthen dam at Gutou would be rebuilt as a stone dam per precedent, and all three former earthen dams removed.

sentences.zh: 金溝閘自河內創建滾水石堰，長一百七十尺，高一丈，闊一丈。

translations.literal: A stone overflow weir was newly built in the river at the Jingou Lock: one hundred and seventy chi long, one zhang high, and one zhang wide.
translations.idiomatic: A stone overflow weir was newly built in the river at the Jingou Lock: one hundred and seventy chi long, one zhang high, and one zhang wide.

sentences.zh: 沽頭閘月河內修截河堰，長一百八十尺，高一丈一尺，底闊二丈，上闊一丈。

translations.literal: In the Gutou bypass channel a cross-river dam was built: one hundred and eighty chi long, one zhang one chi high, two zhang wide at the base and one zhang at the top.
translations.idiomatic: In the Gutou bypass channel a cross-river dam was built: one hundred and eighty chi long, one zhang one chi high, two zhang wide at the base and one zhang at the top.

sentences.zh: 泰定四年四月，御史臺臣言：「巡視河道，自通州至真、揚，會集都水分監及瀕河州縣官民，詢考利病，不出兩端，一曰壅決，二曰經行。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year of Taiding, censorate officials reported: "Inspecting the canal from Tongzhou to Zhen and Yang, convening the Branch Directorate and officials and people of riverine prefectures and counties, we found the benefits and harms reduce to two points: blockage and breach, and passage.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year of Taiding (1327), censorate officials reported that in inspecting the canal from Tongzhou to Zhen and Yang, and convening the Branch Directorate and officials and people of riverine prefectures and counties, they found the benefits and harms reduced to two points: blockage and breach, and passage.

sentences.zh: 卑職參詳，自古立國，引漕皆有成式。

translations.literal: Your humble servant has reviewed the matter: since antiquity every state that established itself had fixed norms for drawing grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: Your humble servant has reviewed the matter: since antiquity every state that established itself had fixed norms for drawing grain transport.

sentences.zh: 自世祖屈群策，濟萬民，疏河渠，引清、濟、汶、泗，立閘節水，以通燕薊、江淮，舟楫萬里，振古所無。

translations.literal: Since Emperor Shizu gathered counsel from all sides to aid the myriad people, dredged rivers and canals, drew in the Qing, Ji, Wen, and Si, and erected locks to regulate water, linking Yanji and the Jiang-Huai—a thousand-li waterway unmatched since antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Since Emperor Shizu gathered counsel from all sides to aid the myriad people, dredged rivers and canals, drew in the Qing, Ji, Wen, and Si, and erected locks to regulate water, he linked Yanji and the Jiang-Huai in a thousand-li waterway unmatched since antiquity.

sentences.zh: 後人篤守成規，茍能舉其廢墜而已，實萬世無窮之利也。

translations.literal: If later generations faithfully kept the established rules and merely restored what fell into ruin, that alone would be a benefit without end for ten thousand ages.
translations.idiomatic: If later generations faithfully kept the established rules and merely restored what fell into ruin, that alone would be a benefit without end for ten thousand ages.

sentences.zh: 蓋水性流變不常，久廢不修，舊規漸壞，雖有智者，不能善後。

translations.literal: Water's nature is changeable and never constant; long neglect lets old norms decay, and even the wise cannot set things right afterward.
translations.idiomatic: Water's nature is changeable and never constant; long neglect lets old norms decay, and even the wise cannot set things right afterward.

sentences.zh: 以故詳歷考視，酌古準今，參會眾議，輒有管見，倘蒙采錄，責任水監，謹守勿失，能事畢矣。

translations.literal: For this reason, after detailed inspection, weighing past against present and joining everyone's counsel, I venture a few views. If they are adopted, charge the Directorate of Waterways to guard them carefully without lapse—that will suffice.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason, after detailed inspection, weighing past against present and joining everyone's counsel, I venture a few views. If they are adopted, charge the Directorate of Waterways to guard them carefully without lapse—that will suffice.

sentences.zh: 不窮利病之源，頻歲差人，具文巡視，徒為煩擾，無益於事。

translations.literal: Without getting to the root of benefits and harms, sending inspectors year after year with formal reports only harasses people and helps nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Without getting to the root of benefits and harms, sending inspectors year after year with formal reports only harasses people and helps nothing.

sentences.zh: 都水監元立南北隘閘，各闊九尺，二百料下船梁頭八尺五寸，可以入閘。

translations.literal: The Directorate's original north and south restrictive locks were each nine chi wide; boats of up to two hundred materials with a beam of eight chi five cun could pass.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate's original north and south restrictive locks were each nine chi wide; boats of up to two hundred materials with a beam of eight chi five cun could pass.

sentences.zh: 愚民嗜利無厭，為隘閘所限，改造減舷添倉長船至八九十尺，甚至百尺，皆五六百料，入至閘內，不能回轉，動輒淺閣，阻礙余舟，蓋緣隘閘之法，不能限其長短。

translations.literal: The ignorant public, insatiable for profit, hemmed in by the restrictive locks, refitted boats with lowered sides and lengthened holds—eighty or ninety chi, even one hundred chi, all five or six hundred materials. Once inside the lock they cannot turn; they run aground and block other boats, because the restrictive-lock rule limits width but not length.
translations.idiomatic: The ignorant public, insatiable for profit, hemmed in by the restrictive locks, refitted boats with lowered sides and lengthened holds—eighty or ninety chi, even one hundred chi, all five or six hundred materials. Once inside a lock they could not turn; they ran aground and blocked other boats, because the restrictive-lock rule limited width but not length.

sentences.zh: 今卑職至真州，問得造船作頭，稱過閘船梁八尺五寸船，該長六丈五尺，計二百料。

translations.literal: Your servant went to Zhenzhou and questioned a master shipwright, who said a lock-passing boat with an eight-chi-five-cun beam should be six zhang five chi long, reckoned at two hundred materials.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant went to Zhenzhou and questioned a master shipwright, who said a lock-passing boat with an eight-chi-five-cun beam should be six zhang five chi long, reckoned at two hundred materials.

sentences.zh: 由是參詳，宜於隘閘下岸立石則，遇船入閘，必須驗量，長不過則，然後放入，違者罪之。

translations.literal: On this basis I propose erecting a stone gauge on the bank below the restrictive lock: any boat entering must be measured, and none longer than the gauge may pass; violators shall be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On this basis I propose erecting a stone gauge on the bank below the restrictive lock: any boat entering must be measured, and none longer than the gauge may pass; violators shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 閘內舊有長船，立限遣出。」

translations.literal: Long boats already inside the lock should be given a deadline to leave."
translations.idiomatic: Long boats already inside the lock should be given a deadline to leave.

sentences.zh: 省下都水監，委濠寨官約會濟寧路委官同歷視議擬，隘閘下約八十步河北立二石則，中間相離六十五尺，如舟至彼，驗量如式，方許入閘，有長者罪遣退之。

translations.literal: The Secretariat sent this down to the Directorate of Waterways, which delegated garrison officials to meet Jining Circuit officers for joint inspection. Below the restrictive lock, about eighty paces north of the river, two stone gauges were to be placed sixty-five chi apart; boats arriving there must be measured accordingly before entering the lock, and any too long would be punished and turned back.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat sent this down to the Directorate of Waterways, which delegated garrison officials to meet Jining Circuit officers for joint inspection. Below the restrictive lock, about eighty paces north of the river, two stone gauges were to be placed sixty-five chi apart; boats arriving there must be measured accordingly before entering the lock, and any too long would be punished and turned back.

sentences.zh: 又與東昌路官親詣議擬，於元立隘閘西約一里，依已定丈尺，置石則驗量行舟，有不依元料者罪之。

translations.literal: They also met in person with Dongchang Circuit officials and planned, about one li west of the originally established restrictive lock, to set stone gauges at the prescribed dimensions to measure passing boats; those not meeting the original material standard would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: They also met in person with Dongchang Circuit officials and planned, about one li west of the originally established restrictive lock, to set stone gauges at the prescribed dimensions to measure passing boats; those not meeting the original material standard would be punished.

sentences.zh: 天歷三年三月，詔諭中外：「都水監言：世祖費國家財用，開闢會通河，以通漕運。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year of Tianli, an edict announced to court and country: "The Directorate of Waterways reports: Emperor Shizu spent state funds to open the Huitong Canal for grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year of Tianli (1330), an edict announced to court and country: the Directorate of Waterways reported that Emperor Shizu had spent state funds to open the Huitong Canal for grain transport.

sentences.zh: 往來使臣、下番百姓及隨從使臣、各枝斡脫權勢之人，到閘不候水則，恃勢捶撻看閘人等，頻頻啟放。

translations.literal: Envoys in transit, commoners returning from overseas service, their attendants, and powerful persons from every branch and ortoq arrive at locks without waiting for the proper water level, rely on their influence to beat the lock keepers, and demand frequent openings.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys in transit, commoners returning from overseas service, their attendants, and powerful persons from every branch and ortoq arrived at locks without waiting for the proper water level, relied on their influence to beat the lock keepers, and demanded frequent openings.

sentences.zh: 又漕運糧船，凡遇水淺，於河內築土壩，積水以漸行舟，以故壞閘。

translations.literal: Grain transport boats, whenever the water runs shallow, build earthen dams in the river to store water for gradual passage—and thus damage the locks.
translations.idiomatic: Grain transport boats, whenever the water ran shallow, built earthen dams in the river to store water for gradual passage—and thus damaged the locks.

sentences.zh: 乞禁治事。

translations.literal: We ask that this be forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that this be forbidden.

sentences.zh: 命後諸王駙馬各枝往來使臣及幹脫權勢之人、下番使臣等，並運官糧船，如到閘，依舊定例啟閉。

translations.literal: Henceforth imperial princes, imperial sons-in-law, envoys of every branch, powerful ortoq persons, and envoys returning from overseas service, together with official grain boats, must open and close locks according to the established rules when they arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth imperial princes, imperial sons-in-law, envoys of every branch, powerful ortoq persons, and envoys returning from overseas service, together with official grain boats, must open and close locks according to the established rules when they arrive.

sentences.zh: 若似前不候水則，恃勢捶拷守閘人等，勒令啟閘，及河內用土築壩壞閘之人，治其罪。

translations.literal: Those who as before ignore the water level, rely on influence to beat and torture lock keepers and force openings, or build earthen dams in the river and damage locks, shall be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Those who as before ignored the water level, relied on influence to beat and torture lock keepers and force openings, or built earthen dams in the river and damaged locks, would be punished.

sentences.zh: 如守閘之人，恃有聖旨，合啟閘時，故意遲延，阻滯使臣客旅，欺要錢物，乃不畏常憲也。」

translations.literal: If lock keepers, relying on this edict, deliberately delay when locks should open, obstruct envoys and travelers, and extort money and goods—that is contempt for ordinary law."
translations.idiomatic: If lock keepers, relying on this edict, deliberately delayed when locks should open, obstructed envoys and travelers, and extorted money and goods—that was contempt for ordinary law.

sentences.zh: 仍令監察御史、廉訪司常加體察。

translations.literal: Censorial investigators and the surveillance commissions were also ordered to monitor this constantly.
translations.idiomatic: Censorial investigators and the surveillance commissions were also ordered to monitor this constantly.

sentences.zh: 兗州閘兗州閘已見前。

translations.literal: The Yanzhou Lock—the Yanzhou Lock has already been described above.
translations.idiomatic: The Yanzhou Lock—the Yanzhou Lock has already been described above.

sentences.zh: 至元二十七年四月，都漕運副使馬之貞言：

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-seventh year of Zhiyuan, Vice Director Ma Zhizhen of the Directorate of Grain Transport reported:
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twenty-seventh year of Zhiyuan (1290), Vice Director Ma Zhizhen of the Directorate of Grain Transport reported:

sentences.zh: 準山東東西道宣慰使司牒文，相視兗州閘堰事。

translations.literal: Per a dispatch from the Shanxi-East and -West Circuit Pacification Commission, he inspected the Yanzhou lock and weir.
translations.idiomatic: Per a dispatch from the Shanxi-East and -West Circuit Pacification Commission, he inspected the Yanzhou lock and weir.

sentences.zh: 先於至元十二年蒙丞相伯顏訪問自江淮達大都河道，之貞乃言，宋、金以來，汶、泗相通河道，郭都水按視，可以通漕。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the twelfth year of Zhiyuan, Chancellor Bayan had inquired about the water route from the Jiang-Huai to the capital. Zhizhen replied that since Song and Jin times the connecting channel between the Wen and Si had been surveyed by Director Guo and could serve grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in the twelfth year of Zhiyuan (1275), Chancellor Bayan had inquired about the water route from the Jiang-Huai to the capital. Zhizhen replied that since Song and Jin times the connecting channel between the Wen and Si had been surveyed by Director Guo and could serve grain transport.

sentences.zh: 於二十年中書省奏準，委兵部李尚書等開鑿，擬修石閘十四。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the Central Secretariat memorialized for approval and entrusted Minister Li of the Ministry of War and others to excavate it, planning fourteen stone locks.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year (1283) the Central Secretariat memorialized for approval and entrusted Minister Li of the Ministry of War and others to excavate it, planning fourteen stone locks.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，省委之貞與尚監察等同相視，擬修石閘八、石堰二，除已修畢外，有石閘一、石堰一、堽城石堰一，至今未修。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the province sent Zhizhen with Censor Shang and others to inspect jointly; they planned eight stone locks and two stone weirs. Aside from what was already finished, one stone lock, one stone weir, and the Gangcheng stone weir remain unrepaired to this day.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year (1284) the province sent Zhizhen with Censor Shang and others to inspect jointly; they planned eight stone locks and two stone weirs. Aside from what was already finished, one stone lock, one stone weir, and the Gangcheng stone weir remained unrepaired to this day.

sentences.zh: 據濟州以南，徐、邳沿河纖道橋梁，二十三年添立邳州水站，移文沿河州縣，修治已完。

translations.literal: South of Jizhou, towpaths and bridges along Xu and Pi had been repaired after a water station was added at Pizhou in the twenty-third year and orders sent to riverine prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: South of Jizhou, towpaths and bridges along Xu and Pi had been repaired after a water station was added at Pizhou in the twenty-third year (1286) and orders sent to riverine prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 二十三年調之貞充漕運副使，委管閘接放綱船。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Zhizhen was appointed Vice Director of Grain Transport and charged with managing locks and releasing convoy boats.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Zhizhen was appointed Vice Director of Grain Transport and charged with managing locks and releasing convoy boats.

sentences.zh: 沿河纖道，元無崩損去處，在前年例，當麻麥盛時，差官修理閘道，督責地主割刈麻麥，並滕州開決稻堰，泗源磨堰，差人於呂梁百步等祇，及濟州閘監督江淮綱運船只，過祇出閘，不令阻滯客旅，茍取錢物。

translations.literal: Along the towpaths there had been no collapses. Under the yearly custom, when hemp and wheat were flourishing, officials were sent to repair lock paths, supervising landowners to cut the crops, opening rice weirs at Tengzhou, the Moyan weir at Siyuan, posting men at Lüliang, Baibu, and other posts, and supervising Jiang-Huai convoy boats at the Jizhou lock so they passed posts and left locks without blocking travelers or extorting money.
translations.idiomatic: Along the towpaths there had been no collapses. Under the yearly custom, when hemp and wheat were flourishing, officials were sent to repair lock paths and supervise landowners in cutting the crops. Rice weirs were opened at Tengzhou, the Moyan weir at Siyuan; men were posted at Lüliang, Baibu, and other stations; and at the Jizhou lock Jiang-Huai convoy boats were supervised so they passed posts and left locks without blocking travelers or extorting money.

sentences.zh: 據新開會通並濟州汶、泗相通河，非自然長流河道，於兗州立閘堰，約泗水西流，堽城立閘堰，分汶水入河，南會於濟州，以六閘撙節水勢，啟閉通放舟楫，南通淮、泗，以入新開會通河，至於通州。

translations.literal: The newly opened Huitong Canal together with the Jizhou connecting channel between Wen and Si is not a naturally flowing river. At Yanzhou a lock and weir restrain the Si flowing west; at Gangcheng a lock and weir divide Wen water into the canal, which joins at Jizhou; six locks regulate the water, opening and closing to pass boats south to the Huai and Si and into the new Huitong Canal as far as Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The newly opened Huitong Canal together with the Jizhou connecting channel between Wen and Si was not a naturally flowing river. At Yanzhou a lock and weir restrained the Si flowing west; at Gangcheng a lock and weir divided Wen water into the canal, which joined at Jizhou. Six locks regulated the water, opening and closing to pass boats south to the Huai and Si and into the new Huitong Canal as far as Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 近去歲四月，江淮都漕運使司言，本司糧運，經濟河至東阿交割，前者濟州運司，不時移文瀕河官司，修治纖道，若有緩急處所，正官取招呈省，路經歷、縣達魯花赤以下就便斷罪。

translations.literal: Last year in the fourth month the Jiang-Huai Directorate of Grain Transport reported that its grain convoys were handed over at Dong'e after passing the Ji River. Formerly the Jizhou transport office repeatedly sent orders to riverine authorities to repair towpaths; for urgent problems responsible officials would be interrogated and reported to the province, and circuit intendants and county darughachi and below could be sentenced on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: Last year in the fourth month the Jiang-Huai Directorate of Grain Transport reported that its grain convoys were handed over at Dong'e after passing the Ji River. Formerly the Jizhou transport office repeatedly sent orders to riverine authorities to repair towpaths; for urgent problems responsible officials would be interrogated and reported to the province, and circuit intendants and county darughachi and below could be sentenced on the spot.

sentences.zh: 今濟州漕司革罷，其河道撥屬都漕運司管領，本司糧運未到東阿，凡有阻滯，並是本司遲慢。

translations.literal: Now the Jizhou transport office has been abolished and its river section assigned to the Directorate of Grain Transport; if grain has not reached Dong'e, any delay is this directorate's fault.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Jizhou transport office had been abolished and its river section assigned to the Directorate of Grain Transport; if grain had not reached Dong'e, any delay was this directorate's fault.

sentences.zh: 迤南河道，從此無人管領，不時水勢泛溢，堤岸摧塌，澀滯河道。

translations.literal: The river stretch to the south now has no overseer; floods often burst embankments and choke the channel.
translations.idiomatic: The river stretch to the south now had no overseer; floods often burst embankments and choked the channel.

sentences.zh: 又濟州閘，前濟州運司正官親臨監視，其押綱船戶不敢分爭。

translations.literal: At the Jizhou lock, the chief officer of the former Jizhou transport office personally supervised, so convoy guards and boatmen dared not quarrel.
translations.idiomatic: At the Jizhou lock, the chief officer of the former Jizhou transport office had personally supervised, so convoy guards and boatmen dared not quarrel.

sentences.zh: 即目各處官司差人管領，與綱官船戶各無統攝，爭要水勢，及攙越過閘，互相毆打，以致損壞船只，浸沒官糧。

translations.literal: Now officials dispatched from various offices and convoy guards and boatmen have no unified command; they fight over water levels, cut ahead at locks, beat one another, damage boats, and sink official grain.
translations.idiomatic: Now officials dispatched from various offices and convoy guards and boatmen had no unified command; they fought over water levels, cut ahead at locks, beat one another, damaged boats, and sank official grain.

sentences.zh: 擬將東阿河道撥付江淮都漕運司提調管領，庶幾不誤糧運，都省準焉。

translations.literal: It was proposed to assign the Dong'e river section to the Jiang-Huai Directorate for overall supervision so grain transport would not suffer; the Metropolitan Secretariat approved.
translations.idiomatic: It was proposed to assign the Dong'e river section to the Jiang-Huai Directorate for overall supervision so grain transport would not suffer; the Metropolitan Secretariat approved.

sentences.zh: 又準江淮都漕運司副使言，除委官看管閘堰外，據汶、泗、堽城二閘一堰、泗河兗州閘堰、濟州城南閘，乃會通河上源之喉衿，去歲流水沖壞堽城汶河土堰、兗州泗河土堰，必須移文兗州、泰安州差夫修閉。

translations.literal: The Jiang-Huai Vice Director also reported that besides posting officials to guard locks and weirs, the two locks and one weir at Wen-Si-Gangcheng, the Yanzhou lock and weir on the Si River, and the south Jizhou lock are the throat of the Huitong Canal's upper reaches. Last year floodwater destroyed the Gangcheng Wen River earthen weir and the Yanzhou Si River earthen weir; orders must go to Yanzhou and Tai'an to dispatch labor for repairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiang-Huai Vice Director also reported that besides posting officials to guard locks and weirs, the two locks and one weir at Wen-Si-Gangcheng, the Yanzhou lock and weir on the Si River, and the south Jizhou lock were the throat of the Huitong Canal's upper reaches. Last year floodwater had destroyed the Gangcheng Wen River earthen weir and the Yanzhou Si River earthen weir; orders must go to Yanzhou and Tai'an to dispatch labor for repairs.

sentences.zh: 又被漲水沖破梁山一帶堤堰，走泄水勢，通入舊河，以致新河水小，澀糧船，乞移文斷事等官，轉下東平路修閉，上流撥屬江淮漕運司，下流屬之貞管領。

translations.literal: Floodwater also breached embankments around Mount Liang, draining water into the old river so the new channel ran low and grain boats stalled. They asked investigating officials to relay orders to Dongping Circuit for repairs—the upper reach assigned to the Jiang-Huai transport directorate, the lower reach to Zhizhen.
translations.idiomatic: Floodwater had also breached embankments around Mount Liang, draining water into the old river so the new channel ran low and grain boats stalled. They asked investigating officials to relay orders to Dongping Circuit for repairs—the upper reach assigned to the Jiang-Huai transport directorate, the lower reach to Zhizhen.

sentences.zh: 若已後新河水小，直下濟州監閘官，並泰安、兗州、東平修理。

translations.literal: If afterward the new river ran low, the Jizhou lock supervisors and Tai'an, Yanzhou, and Dongping would handle repairs directly.
translations.idiomatic: If afterward the new river ran low, the Jizhou lock supervisors and Tai'an, Yanzhou, and Dongping would handle repairs directly.

sentences.zh: 據兗州石閘一所、石堰一道，堽城石閘一道，合用材物已行措置完備，必須修理，雖初經之貞相視會計，即令不隸管領，乞移文江淮漕司修治。

translations.literal: Materials for one Yanzhou stone lock, one stone weir, and one Gangcheng stone lock had been fully prepared and must be built. Although Zhizhen had inspected and accounted for them, they are no longer under his jurisdiction; he asked the Jiang-Huai transport office be ordered to repair them.
translations.idiomatic: Materials for one Yanzhou stone lock, one stone weir, and one Gangcheng stone lock had been fully prepared and must be built. Although Zhizhen had inspected and accounted for them, they were no longer under his jurisdiction; he asked that the Jiang-Huai transport office be ordered to repair them.

sentences.zh: 其泰安州堽城安、梁山一帶堤岸，濟州閘等處，雖是撥屬江淮漕司，今後倘若水漲，沖壞堤堰，亦乞照會東平、濟寧、泰安，如承文字，亦仰奉行。

translations.literal: For embankments around Gangcheng'an and Mount Liang in Tai'an, the Jizhou lock, and other sites—though assigned to the Jiang-Huai transport office—if future floods destroy dikes, he also asked that Dongping, Jining, and Tai'an be notified and obey any orders received.
translations.idiomatic: For embankments around Gangcheng'an and Mount Liang in Tai'an, the Jizhou lock, and other sites—though assigned to the Jiang-Huai transport office—if future floods destroyed dikes, he also asked that Dongping, Jining, and Tai'an be notified and obey any orders received.

sentences.zh: 又東阿、須城界安山閘，為糧船不由舊河來往，江淮所委監閘官已去，目今無人看管，必須之貞修理，以此權委人守焉。

translations.literal: At the Anshan lock on the border of Dong'e and Xucheng, grain boats no longer used the old river; the lock supervisor dispatched by Jiang-Huai had departed and no one was watching the lock. Zhizhen had to repair it and temporarily appoint a keeper.
translations.idiomatic: At the Anshan lock on the border of Dong'e and Xucheng, grain boats no longer used the old river; the lock supervisor dispatched by Jiang-Huai had departed and no one was watching the lock. Zhizhen had to repair it and temporarily appoint a keeper.
